question: T20 ਇਤਿਹਾਸ ਵਿੱਚ Australia ਦੇ ਖਿਲਾਫ਼ ਕਿਸ ਬੱਲੇਬਾਜ਼ ਦੀ ਬੱਲੇਬਾਜ਼ੀ ਔਸਤ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਹੈ?
gold_sql: SELECT p.player_name, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS total_runs, SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id = d.striker_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS times_dismissed, ROUND(CAST(SUM(d.runs_scored) AS FLOAT) / CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id = d.striker_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id = d.striker_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) END, 2) AS batting_average FROM Deliveries d JOIN Players p ON d.striker_id = p.player_id WHERE d.bowling_team = 'Australia' GROUP BY d.striker_id, p.player_name HAVING SUM(d.runs_scored) > 50 ORDER BY batting_average DESC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
WITH BattingStats AS (
    SELECT 
        p.player_name,
        SUM(d.runs_scored) AS total_runs,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field') THEN d.match_id END) AS times_dismissed
    FROM Deliveries d
    JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
    JOIN Players p ON d.striker_id = p.player_id
    WHERE m.team1 = 'Australia' OR m.team2 = 'Australia'
    GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name
)
SELECT 
    player_name,
    total_runs,
    times_dismissed,
    CASE 
        WHEN times_dismissed > 0 THEN ROUND(CAST(total_runs AS REAL) / times_dismissed, 2)
        ELSE NULL 
    END AS batting_average
FROM BattingStats
WHERE total_runs > 0
ORDER BY batting_average DESC
LIMIT 1;

question: Across all T20 World Cup editions, which team has used the most bowlers in a single innings and did that strategy result in a win or loss?
gold_sql: SELECT d.bowling_team, COUNT(DISTINCT d.bowler_id) AS total_bowlers_used, CASE WHEN d.bowling_team = m.match_winner THEN 'Win' WHEN m.match_winner IS NULL AND m.result_type IN ('tie', 'no result') THEN 'Tie/No Result' ELSE 'Loss' END AS match_result FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.bowling_team, m.match_winner, m.result_type ORDER BY total_bowlers_used DESC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
WITH BowlerUsage AS (
    SELECT 
        d.match_id,
        d.inning,
        d.bowling_team,
        COUNT(DISTINCT d.bowler_id) AS total_bowlers_used
    FROM Deliveries d
    JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
    WHERE m.season LIKE '%T20 World Cup%'
    GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.bowling_team
),
MaxBowlers AS (
    SELECT 
        bowling_team,
        total_bowlers_used,
        match_id
    FROM BowlerUsage
    WHERE total_bowlers_used = (SELECT MAX(total_bowlers_used) FROM BowlerUsage)
)
SELECT 
    mbu.bowling_team,
    mbu.total_bowlers_used,
    CASE 
        WHEN m.match_winner = mbu.bowling_team THEN 'win'
        ELSE 'loss'
    END AS match_result
FROM MaxBowlers mbu
JOIN Matches m ON mbu.match_id = m.match_id
ORDER BY mbu.total_bowlers_used DESC, mbu.bowling_team
LIMIT 1;

question: Which Batsmen has the highest batting average against Australia in T20 history?
gold_sql: SELECT p.player_name, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS total_runs, SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id = d.striker_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS times_dismissed, ROUND(CAST(SUM(d.runs_scored) AS FLOAT) / CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id = d.striker_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id = d.striker_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) END, 2) AS batting_average FROM Deliveries d JOIN Players p ON d.striker_id = p.player_id WHERE d.bowling_team = 'Australia' GROUP BY d.striker_id, p.player_name HAVING SUM(d.runs_scored) > 50 ORDER BY batting_average DESC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
WITH BatsmanStats AS (
    SELECT 
        p.player_name,
        SUM(d.runs_scored) AS total_runs,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE 
            WHEN d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL 
            AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field') 
            THEN d.match_id || '-' || d.inning || '-' || d.striker_id 
        END) AS times_dismissed
    FROM Deliveries d
    JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
    JOIN Players p ON d.striker_id = p.player_id
    WHERE m.season LIKE '%T20%'
    AND (
        (d.batting_team != 'Australia' AND d.bowling_team = 'Australia')
        OR
        (m.team1 = 'Australia' AND m.team2 != d.batting_team)
        OR
        (m.team2 = 'Australia' AND m.team1 != d.batting_team)
    )
    GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name
    HAVING total_runs > 0
)
SELECT 
    player_name,
    total_runs,
    times_dismissed,
    CASE 
        WHEN times_dismissed = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE ROUND(CAST(total_runs AS REAL) / times_dismissed, 2)
    END AS batting_average
FROM BatsmanStats
ORDER BY batting_average DESC NULLS LAST, total_runs DESC
LIMIT 1;

question: टी20 इतिहास में ऑस्ट्रेलिया के खिलाफ सबसे अधिक बल्लेबाजी औसत किस बल्लेबाज़ का है?
gold_sql: SELECT p.player_name, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS total_runs, SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id = d.striker_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS times_dismissed, ROUND(CAST(SUM(d.runs_scored) AS FLOAT) / CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id = d.striker_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id = d.striker_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) END, 2) AS batting_average FROM Deliveries d JOIN Players p ON d.striker_id = p.player_id WHERE d.bowling_team = 'Australia' GROUP BY d.striker_id, p.player_name HAVING SUM(d.runs_scored) > 50 ORDER BY batting_average DESC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
WITH AustraliaMatches AS (
    SELECT match_id
    FROM Matches
    WHERE (team1 = 'Australia' OR team2 = 'Australia')
),
PlayerRuns AS (
    SELECT 
        d.striker_id AS player_id,
        SUM(d.runs_scored) AS total_runs
    FROM Deliveries d
    INNER JOIN AustraliaMatches am ON d.match_id = am.match_id
    WHERE d.batting_team != 'Australia'
    GROUP BY d.striker_id
),
PlayerDismissals AS (
    SELECT 
        d.striker_id AS player_id,
        COUNT(*) AS times_dismissed
    FROM Deliveries d
    INNER JOIN AustraliaMatches am ON d.match_id = am.match_id
    WHERE d.batting_team != 'Australia'
        AND d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL
        AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field')
    GROUP BY d.striker_id
)
SELECT 
    p.player_name,
    pr.total_runs,
    COALESCE(pd.times_dismissed, 0) AS times_dismissed,
    CASE 
        WHEN COALESCE(pd.times_dismissed, 0) = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE ROUND(CAST(pr.total_runs AS REAL) / pd.times_dismissed, 2)
    END AS batting_average
FROM PlayerRuns pr
INNER JOIN Players p ON pr.player_id = p.player_id
LEFT JOIN PlayerDismissals pd ON pr.player_id = pd.player_id
ORDER BY batting_average DESC
LIMIT 1;

question: T20 వరల్డ్ కప్పు ఎడిషన్లలో ఒక ఇన్నింగ్స్లో ఏ టీం అన్నిటికన్నా ఎక్కువ బౌలర్లని వాదింది? అప్పుడు వాళ్ళు ఒడిపోయారా లేదా గెలిచారా?
gold_sql: SELECT d.bowling_team, COUNT(DISTINCT d.bowler_id) AS total_bowlers_used, CASE WHEN d.bowling_team = m.match_winner THEN 'Win' WHEN m.match_winner IS NULL AND m.result_type IN ('tie', 'no result') THEN 'Tie/No Result' ELSE 'Loss' END AS match_result FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.bowling_team, m.match_winner, m.result_type ORDER BY total_bowlers_used DESC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
WITH T20WorldCupMatches AS (
    SELECT match_id, team1, team2, match_winner
    FROM Matches
    WHERE season LIKE '%T20 World Cup%'
),
BowlersPerInning AS (
    SELECT 
        d.match_id,
        d.inning,
        d.bowling_team,
        COUNT(DISTINCT d.bowler_id) AS bowlers_used
    FROM Deliveries d
    JOIN T20WorldCupMatches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id

    END AS match_result

question: Which bowler has the best economy rate in overs 17-20 across all T20 World Cups, with a minimum of 100 balls bowled in that phase?
gold_sql: SELECT p.player_name FROM Players p JOIN Deliveries d ON p.player_id = d.bowler_id WHERE d.over_number BETWEEN 17 AND 20 GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 100 ORDER BY (SUM(d.runs_scored + d.wides + d.noballs) * 6.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) ASC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
WITH PhaseDeliveries AS (
    SELECT 
        d.bowler_id,
        d.match_id,
        d.inning,
        d.over_number,
        d.ball_number,
        d.runs_scored,
        d.extra_runs,
        d.wides,
        d.noballs,
        d.byes,
        d.legbyes
    FROM Deliveries d
    JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
    WHERE m.season LIKE '%T20 World Cup%'
        AND d.over_number BETWEEN 17 AND 20
),
BowlerPhaseStats AS (
    SELECT 
        bowler_id,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN wides = 0 AND noballs = 0 THEN 1 END) AS legal_balls,
        SUM(runs_scored + extra_runs - byes - legbyes) AS conceded_runs
    FROM PhaseDeliveries
    GROUP BY bowler_id
    HAVING legal_balls >= 100
),
EconomyRates AS (
    SELECT 
        bowler_id,
        ROUND(conceded_runs * 6.0 / legal_balls, 2) AS economy_rate
    FROM BowlerPhaseStats
)
SELECT 
    p.player_name
FROM EconomyRates er
JOIN Players p ON er.bowler_id = p.player_id
ORDER BY er.economy_rate ASC
LIMIT 1;

question: सभी टी20 विश्व कप संस्करणों में, एक पारी में सबसे ज़्यादा गेंदबाज़ों का उपयोग किस टीम ने किया और क्या उस रणनीति का परिणाम जीत रहा या हार?
gold_sql: SELECT d.bowling_team, COUNT(DISTINCT d.bowler_id) AS total_bowlers_used, CASE WHEN d.bowling_team = m.match_winner THEN 'Win' WHEN m.match_winner IS NULL AND m.result_type IN ('tie', 'no result') THEN 'Tie/No Result' ELSE 'Loss' END AS match_result FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.bowling_team, m.match_winner, m.result_type ORDER BY total_bowlers_used DESC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
WITH InningBowlers AS (
    SELECT 
        d.match_id,
        d.inning,
        d.bowling_team,
        COUNT(DISTINCT d.bowler_id) AS bowlers_used
    FROM Deliveries d
    JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
    WHERE m.season LIKE '%T20 World Cup%'
    GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.bowling_team
),
MaxBowlersPerInning AS (
    SELECT 
        match_id,
        inning,
        bowling_team,
        bowlers_used,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY bowlers_used DESC) AS rank_bowlers
    FROM InningBowlers
),
TeamMatchResult AS (
    SELECT 
        m.match_id,
        m.match_winner,
        CASE 
            WHEN m.match_winner = m.team1 THEN m.team1
            WHEN m.match_winner = m.team2 THEN m.team2

)
SELECT 
    mbi.bowling_team,
    mbi.bowlers_used AS total_bowlers_used,
    CASE 
        WHEN tmr.winning_team = mbi.bowling_team THEN 'win'
        ELSE 'loss' 
    END AS match_result
FROM MaxBowlersPerInning mbi
JOIN TeamMatchResult tmr ON mbi.match_id = tmr.match_id
WHERE mbi.rank_bowlers = 1
ORDER BY mbi.bowlers_used DESC, mbi.match_id, mbi.inning;

question: सभी टी20 विश्व कपों में, 17-20 ओवरों में कम-से-कम 100 वैध गेंदें फेंकने वालों में सबसे बेहतरीन इकॉनमी रेट किस गेंदबाज़ का है?
gold_sql: SELECT p.player_name FROM Players p JOIN Deliveries d ON p.player_id = d.bowler_id WHERE d.over_number BETWEEN 17 AND 20 GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 100 ORDER BY (SUM(d.runs_scored + d.wides + d.noballs) * 6.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) ASC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
WITH ValidDeliveries AS (
    SELECT 
        d.match_id,
        d.inning,
        d.over_number,
        d.bowler_id,
        d.runs_scored,
        d.extra_runs,
        d.wides,
        d.noballs
    FROM Deliveries d
    JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
    WHERE m.season LIKE '%T20 World Cup%'
      AND d.over_number BETWEEN 17 AND 20

)
SELECT

FROM BowlerStats bs
JOIN Players p ON bs.bowler_id = p.player_id
ORDER BY (bs.runs_conceded * 1.0 / bs.balls_bowled) ASC
LIMIT 1;

question: ਸਾਰੇ T20 ਵਿਸ਼ਵ ਕੱਪ ਐਡੀਸ਼ਨਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ, ਕਿਸ ਟੀਮ ਨੇ ਇੱਕੋ ਪਾਰੀ ਵਿੱਚ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਗੇਂਦਬਾਜ਼ਾਂ ਦੀ ਵਰਤੋਂ ਕੀਤੀ ਅਤੇ ਕੀ ਉਹ ਰਣਨੀਤੀ ਜਿੱਤ ਜਾਂ ਹਾਰ ਵਿੱਚ ਬਦਲੀ?
gold_sql: SELECT d.bowling_team, COUNT(DISTINCT d.bowler_id) AS total_bowlers_used, CASE WHEN d.bowling_team = m.match_winner THEN 'Win' WHEN m.match_winner IS NULL AND m.result_type IN ('tie', 'no result') THEN 'Tie/No Result' ELSE 'Loss' END AS match_result FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.bowling_team, m.match_winner, m.result_type ORDER BY total_bowlers_used DESC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
WITH TeamBowlersPerInning AS (
    SELECT 
        m.match_id,
        m.season,
        d.inning,
        d.bowling_team,
        COUNT(DISTINCT d.bowler_id) AS bowlers_used
    FROM Matches m
    JOIN Deliveries d ON m.match_id = d.match_id
    WHERE m.season LIKE '%T20 World Cup%'
    GROUP BY m.match_id, d.inning, d.bowling_team
),
MaxBowlersPerMatch AS (
    SELECT 
        match_id,
        inning,
        bowling_team,
        bowlers_used,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY match_id ORDER BY bowlers_used DESC) AS rank_in_match
    FROM TeamBowlersPerInning
),
TopInnings AS (
    SELECT 
        match_id,
        inning,
        bowling_team,
        bowlers_used
    FROM MaxBowlersPerMatch
    WHERE rank_in_match = 1
),
OverallMax AS (
    SELECT 
        bowling_team,
        bowlers_used AS total_bowlers_used,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY bowlers_used DESC) AS overall_rank
    FROM TopInnings
    GROUP BY bowling_team, bowlers_used
)
SELECT 
    om.bowling_team,
    om.total_bowlers_used,
    CASE 
        WHEN m.match_winner = om.bowling_team THEN 'won'
        WHEN m.match_winner IS NOT NULL AND m.match_winner != om.bowling_team THEN 'lost'
        ELSE 'no result'
    END AS match_result
FROM OverallMax om
JOIN TopInnings ti ON om.bowling_team = ti.bowling_team AND om.total_bowlers_used = ti.bowlers_used
JOIN Matches m ON ti.match_id = m.match_id
WHERE om.overall_rank = 1
GROUP BY om.bowling_team, om.total_bowlers_used, match_result
ORDER BY om.total_bowlers_used DESC, om.bowling_team;

question: అన్నీ T20 వరల్డ్ కప్పులలో ఏ బౌలర్ దగ్గర 17-20 ఓవర్లలో అన్నిటికన్నా మంచి ఎకానమీ రేట్ ఉన్నది? (కనీసం 100 బంతులు విసిరిన)
gold_sql: SELECT p.player_name FROM Players p JOIN Deliveries d ON p.player_id = d.bowler_id WHERE d.over_number BETWEEN 17 AND 20 GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 100 ORDER BY (SUM(d.runs_scored + d.wides + d.noballs) * 6.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) ASC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
WITH OverRangeDeliveries AS (
    SELECT 
        d.bowler_id,
        d.runs_scored,
        d.extra_runs,
        d.wides,
        d.noballs,
        CASE 
            WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 
            ELSE 0 
        END AS legal_ball
    FROM Deliveries d
    WHERE d.over_number BETWEEN 17 AND 20
),
BowlerStats AS (
    SELECT 
        bowler_id,
        COUNT(*) AS total_balls,
        SUM(legal_ball) AS legal_balls_bowled,
        SUM(runs_scored + extra_runs) AS total_runs_conceded
    FROM OverRangeDeliveries
    GROUP BY bowler_id
    HAVING SUM(legal_ball) >= 100
),
EconomyRates AS (
    SELECT

question: T20I ਵਿੱਚ, 10 ਜਾਂ ਵੱਧ ਵਿਕਟਾਂ ਲੈਣ ਵਾਲੇ ਗੇਂਦਬਾਜ਼ਾਂ ਵਿੱਚੋਂ ਕਿਸਦੀ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵਧੀਆ ਔਸਤ ਹੈ, ਅਤੇ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੀ ਇਕਾਨਮੀ ਅਤੇ ਸਟ੍ਰਾਈਕ ਰੇਟ ਕੀ ਹੈ?
gold_sql: SELECT p.player_name, (SUM(d.runs_scored + d.wides + d.noballs) * 1.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'retired out', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS bowling_average, (SUM(d.runs_scored + d.wides + d.noballs) * 6.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS economy_rate, (SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'retired out', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS strike_rate FROM Players p JOIN Deliveries d ON p.player_id = d.bowler_id GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'retired out', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 10 ORDER BY bowling_average ASC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
WITH BowlerStats AS (
    SELECT 
        p.player_id,
        p.player_name,
        COUNT(DISTINCT d.match_id) AS matches,
        SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field') AND d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wickets,
        SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) AS runs_conceded,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN d.match_id || '-' || d.inning || '-' || CAST(d.over_number AS TEXT) || '-' || CAST(d.ball_number AS TEXT) END) AS legal_balls
    FROM Deliveries d
    JOIN Players p ON d.bowler_id = p.player_id
    JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
    WHERE m.season LIKE '%T20I%'
    GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name
    HAVING wickets >= 10
)
SELECT 
    player_name,
    ROUND(CAST(runs_conceded AS REAL) / wickets, 2) AS bowling_average,
    ROUND(CAST(runs_conceded AS REAL) / (legal_balls / 6.0), 2) AS economy_rate,
    ROUND(CAST(legal_balls AS REAL) / wickets, 2) AS strike_rate
FROM BowlerStats
ORDER BY bowling_average ASC
LIMIT 1;

question: Which fielder has the most dismissals in knockout stage matches, and give dismissals per innings as well?
gold_sql: SELECT p.player_name, COUNT(fd.fielder_dismissal_id) AS total_dismissals, (COUNT(fd.fielder_dismissal_id) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pim.match_id) FROM PlayerInMatch pim JOIN Matches m2 ON pim.match_id = m2.match_id WHERE pim.player_id = p.player_id AND m2.stage <> 'Group')) AS dismissals_per_innings FROM Players p JOIN FielderDismissals fd ON p.player_id = fd.fielder_id JOIN Deliveries d ON fd.delivery_id = d.delivery_id JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE m.stage <> 'Group' GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name ORDER BY total_dismissals DESC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
WITH KnockoutMatches AS (
    SELECT match_id
    FROM Matches
    WHERE stage IN ('Final', 'Semi Final', 'Quarter Final', 'Eliminator', 'Qualifier', 'Qualifier 1', 'Qualifier 2', 'Elimination Final')
),
KnockoutDeliveries AS (
    SELECT d.delivery_id, d.match_id, d.inning
    FROM Deliveries d
    JOIN KnockoutMatches km ON d.match_id = km.match_id
    WHERE d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL
),
FielderDismissalsInKnockouts AS (
    SELECT fd.fielder_id, kd.inning, COUNT(*) AS dismissals
    FROM FielderDismissals fd
    JOIN KnockoutDeliveries kd ON fd.delivery_id = kd.delivery_id
    GROUP BY fd.fielder_id, kd.inning
),
TotalDismissals AS (
    SELECT fielder_id, SUM(dismissals) AS total_dismissals
    FROM FielderDismissalsInKnockouts
    GROUP BY fielder_id
),
TopFielder AS (
    SELECT fielder_id, total_dismissals
    FROM TotalDismissals
    ORDER BY total_dismissals DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
DismissalsPerInning AS (
    SELECT 
        tf.fielder_id,
        tf.total_dismissals,
        GROUP_CONCAT(
            fdk.inning || ': ' || fdk.dismissals, 
            ', '
        ) AS dismissals_per_innings
    FROM TopFielder tf
    LEFT JOIN FielderDismissalsInKnockouts fdk ON tf.fielder_id = fdk.fielder_id
    GROUP BY tf.fielder_id, tf.total_dismissals
)
SELECT 
    p.player_name,
    dpi.total_dismissals,
    dpi.dismissals_per_innings
FROM DismissalsPerInning dpi
JOIN Players p ON dpi.fielder_id = p.player_id;

    SELECT 
        b.player_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT d.match_id) AS matches_played,
        SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) AS runs_conceded,
        SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL 
                 AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field') 
                 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wickets_taken,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 END) AS legal_balls_bowled
    FROM Deliveries d

gold_sql: SELECT p.player_name, COUNT(fd.fielder_dismissal_id) AS total_dismissals, (COUNT(fd.fielder_dismissal_id) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pim.match_id) FROM PlayerInMatch pim JOIN Matches m2 ON pim.match_id = m2.match_id WHERE pim.player_id = p.player_id AND m2.stage <> 'Group')) AS dismissals_per_innings FROM Players p JOIN FielderDismissals fd ON p.player_id = fd.fielder_id JOIN Deliveries d ON fd.delivery_id = d.delivery_id JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE m.stage <> 'Group' GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name ORDER BY total_dismissals DESC LIMIT 1;

WITH KnockoutMatches AS (
    SELECT match_id
    FROM Matches
    WHERE stage IN ('Final', 'Semi Final', 'Quarter Final', 'Eliminator', 'Qualifier', 'Qualifier 1', 'Qualifier 2', 'Elimination Final')
),
FielderDismissalsInKnockouts AS (

        fd.fielder_id,
        d.match_id,

        COUNT(*) AS dismissals_in_inning

LIMIT 1;

question: Who has the best average among bowlers with 10+ wickets, and what is their economy and strike rate?
gold_sql: SELECT p.player_name, (SUM(d.runs_scored + d.wides + d.noballs) * 1.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'retired out', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS bowling_average, (SUM(d.runs_scored + d.wides + d.noballs) * 6.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS economy_rate, (SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'retired out', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS strike_rate FROM Players p JOIN Deliveries d ON p.player_id = d.bowler_id GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'retired out', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 10 ORDER BY bowling_average ASC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
WITH BowlerStats AS (
    SELECT 
        p.player_id,
        p.player_name,
        COUNT(DISTINCT d.match_id) AS matches_bowled,
        SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) AS total_runs_conceded,
        SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS legal_balls_bowled,
        SUM(CASE 
            WHEN d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL 
            AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field')
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 
        END) AS total_wickets
    FROM Deliveries d
    JOIN Players p ON d.bowler_id = p.player_id
    GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name
    HAVING total_wickets >= 10
)

    ROUND(CAST(total_runs_conceded AS REAL) / total_wickets, 2) AS bowling_average,

    ROUND(CAST(legal_balls_bowled AS REAL) / total_wickets, 2) AS strike_rate
FROM BowlerStats
ORDER BY bowling_average ASC
LIMIT 1;

question: 10+ వికెట్లు సంపాదించిన బౌలర్లలో ఎవరి దగ్గర అన్నిటికన్నా మంచి ఆవెరేజ్ ఉన్నది? వాళ్ళ ఎకానమీ మరియు స్ట్రైక్ రేట్ ఏమిటి?
gold_sql: SELECT p.player_name, (SUM(d.runs_scored + d.wides + d.noballs) * 1.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'retired out', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS bowling_average, (SUM(d.runs_scored + d.wides + d.noballs) * 6.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS economy_rate, (SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'retired out', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS strike_rate FROM Players p JOIN Deliveries d ON p.player_id = d.bowler_id GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'retired out', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 10 ORDER BY bowling_average ASC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
WITH BowlerStats AS (
    SELECT 
        b.player_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT d.match_id) AS matches,
        SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) AS runs_conceded,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field') AND d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS wickets_taken,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 END) AS legal_balls
    FROM Deliveries d
    JOIN Players b ON d.bowler_id = b.player_id
    GROUP BY b.player_id
    HAVING wickets_taken >= 10
)
SELECT 
    p.player_name,
    ROUND(CAST(bs.runs_conceded AS REAL) / bs.wickets_taken, 2) AS bowling_average,
    ROUND(CAST(bs.runs_conceded AS REAL) / (bs.legal_balls / 6.0), 2) AS economy_rate,
    ROUND(CAST(bs.legal_balls AS REAL) / bs.wickets_taken, 2) AS strike_rate
FROM BowlerStats bs
JOIN Players p ON bs.player_id = p.player_id
ORDER BY bowling_average ASC
LIMIT 1;

question: In T20 history list the top two teams in terms of percentage of matches won ,also give the percentages .
gold_sql: WITH TeamMatches AS (SELECT team1 AS team, match_id, match_winner FROM Matches UNION ALL SELECT team2 AS team, match_id, match_winner FROM Matches) SELECT team, (SUM(CASE WHEN match_winner = team THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(match_id)) AS win_percentage FROM TeamMatches GROUP BY team ORDER BY win_percentage DESC LIMIT 2;
generated_sql:
WITH TeamMatches AS (
    SELECT team1 AS team, match_id FROM Matches
    UNION ALL
    SELECT team2 AS team, match_id FROM Matches
),
TeamWins AS (
    SELECT 
        match_winner AS team,
        COUNT(*) AS wins
    FROM Matches
    WHERE match_winner IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY match_winner
),
TeamStats AS (
    SELECT 
        tm.team,
        COUNT(DISTINCT tm.match_id) AS total_matches,
        COALESCE(tw.wins, 0) AS wins
    FROM TeamMatches tm
    LEFT JOIN TeamWins tw ON tm.team = tw.team
    GROUP BY tm.team
)
SELECT 
    team,
    ROUND(wins * 100.0 / total_matches, 2) AS win_percentage
FROM TeamStats
WHERE total_matches > 0
ORDER BY win_percentage DESC
LIMIT 2;

question: నాకౌట్ మ్యాచులలో ఏ ఫీల్డర్ దగ్గర అన్నిటికన్నా ఎక్కువ వికెట్లు ఉన్నాయి? ఇన్నింగ్స్‌కు సగటు డిస్మిసల్స్ కూడా రాయండి.
gold_sql: SELECT p.player_name, COUNT(fd.fielder_dismissal_id) AS total_dismissals, (COUNT(fd.fielder_dismissal_id) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pim.match_id) FROM PlayerInMatch pim JOIN Matches m2 ON pim.match_id = m2.match_id WHERE pim.player_id = p.player_id AND m2.stage <> 'Group')) AS dismissals_per_innings FROM Players p JOIN FielderDismissals fd ON p.player_id = fd.fielder_id JOIN Deliveries d ON fd.delivery_id = d.delivery_id JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE m.stage <> 'Group' GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name ORDER BY total_dismissals DESC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
WITH KnockoutMatches AS (
    SELECT match_id
    FROM Matches
    WHERE stage IN ('Final', 'Semi Final', 'Quarter Final', 'Eliminator', 'Qualifier', 'Qualifier 1', 'Qualifier 2')
),
FielderDismissalsInKnockouts AS (
    SELECT 
        fd.fielder_id,
        d.match_id,
        d.inning,
        COUNT(*) AS dismissals_in_innings
    FROM FielderDismissals fd
    INNER JOIN Deliveries d ON fd.delivery_id = d.delivery_id
    INNER JOIN KnockoutMatches km ON d.match_id = km.match_id
    GROUP BY fd.fielder_id, d.match_id, d.inning
)
SELECT 
    p.player_name,
    SUM(fdik.dismissals_in_innings) AS total_dismissals,
    ROUND(CAST(SUM(fdik.dismissals_in_innings) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT fdik.match_id || '-' || fdik.inning), 2) AS dismissals_per_innings
FROM FielderDismissalsInKnockouts fdik
INNER JOIN Players p ON fdik.fielder_id = p.player_id
GROUP BY fdik.fielder_id, p.player_name
ORDER BY total_dismissals DESC, dismissals_per_innings DESC;

question: T20 ਇਤਿਹਾਸ ਵਿੱਚ ਮੈਚ ਜਿੱਤਣ ਦੀ ਪ੍ਰਤੀਸ਼ਤ ਦੇ ਹਿਸਾਬ ਨਾਲ ਚੋਟੀ ਦੀਆਂ ਦੋ ਟੀਮਾਂ ਕਿਹੜੀਆਂ ਹਨ, ਅਤੇ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੀਆਂ ਪ੍ਰਤੀਸ਼ਤਾ ਵੀ ਦੱਸੋ?
gold_sql: WITH TeamMatches AS (SELECT team1 AS team, match_id, match_winner FROM Matches UNION ALL SELECT team2 AS team, match_id, match_winner FROM Matches) SELECT team, (SUM(CASE WHEN match_winner = team THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(match_id)) AS win_percentage FROM TeamMatches GROUP BY team ORDER BY win_percentage DESC LIMIT 2;
generated_sql:
WITH TeamMatches AS (
    SELECT team1 AS team, match_id FROM Matches
    UNION ALL
    SELECT team2 AS team, match_id FROM Matches
),
TeamWins AS (
    SELECT 
        team,
        COUNT(*) AS total_matches,
        SUM(CASE WHEN match_winner = team THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wins
    FROM TeamMatches tm
    LEFT JOIN Matches m ON tm.match_id = m.match_id
    GROUP BY team
)
SELECT 
    team,
    ROUND((wins * 100.0) / total_matches, 2) AS win_percentage
FROM TeamWins
WHERE total_matches >= 1
ORDER BY win_percentage DESC
LIMIT 2;

gold_sql: WITH TeamMatches AS (SELECT team1 AS team, match_id, match_winner FROM Matches UNION ALL SELECT team2 AS team, match_id, match_winner FROM Matches) SELECT team, (SUM(CASE WHEN match_winner = team THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(match_id)) AS win_percentage FROM TeamMatches GROUP BY team ORDER BY win_percentage DESC LIMIT 2;

    WHERE stage = 'group' OR stage IS NULL
    GROUP BY team2

generated_sql:
```sql
WITH WicketDeliveries AS (
    SELECT 
        d.match_id,
        d.inning,
        d.striker_id,
        d.runs_scored,
        d.extra_runs,
        d.wides,
        d.noballs,
        d.wicket_type,
        d.player_out_id,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.match_id, d.inning ORDER BY d.over_number, d.ball_number) AS delivery_seq
    FROM Deliveries d
    INNER JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
    WHERE m.season = '2026' AND m.stage = 'T20'
),
WicketIntervals AS (
    SELECT 
        w1.match_id,
        w1.inning,
        w1.striker_id AS player_id,
        w1.delivery_seq AS start_seq,
        COALESCE(MIN(w2.delivery_seq), MAX(w1.delivery_seq) + 1) AS end_seq
    FROM WicketDeliveries w1
    LEFT JOIN WicketDeliveries w2 
        ON w1.match_id = w2.match_id 
        AND w1.inning = w2.inning 
        AND w1.delivery_seq < w2.delivery_seq
        AND w2.player_out_id = w1.striker_id
    WHERE w1.player_out_id = w1.striker_id
        AND w1.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field')
    GROUP BY w1.match_id, w1.inning, w1.striker_id, w1.delivery_seq
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        w1.match_id,
        w1.inning,
        w1.striker_id AS player_id,
        1 AS start_seq,
        MIN(w2.delivery_seq) AS end_seq

question: Which player has the highest strike rate (SR) among all those with exactly 3 ducks, and what is that SR?
gold_sql: WITH PlayerInnings AS (SELECT match_id, striker_id, SUM(runs_scored) AS runs, MAX(CASE WHEN player_out_id = striker_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_out, SUM(runs_scored) AS total_runs, SUM(CASE WHEN wides = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS balls_faced FROM Deliveries GROUP BY match_id, striker_id), PlayerStats AS (SELECT striker_id, SUM(CASE WHEN runs = 0 AND is_out = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS duck_count, SUM(total_runs) AS career_runs, SUM(balls_faced) AS career_balls FROM PlayerInnings GROUP BY striker_id) SELECT p.player_name, (ps.career_runs * 100.0 / ps.career_balls) AS strike_rate FROM PlayerStats ps JOIN Players p ON ps.striker_id = p.player_id WHERE ps.duck_count = 3 AND ps.career_balls > 0 ORDER BY strike_rate DESC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
WITH PlayerDismissals AS (
    SELECT 
        striker_id,
        match_id,
        inning,
        SUM(runs_scored) AS runs_in_innings,
        MAX(CASE 
            WHEN wicket_type IS NOT NULL AND wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field') 
            THEN 1 
            ELSE 0 
        END) AS wicket_taken
    FROM Deliveries
    WHERE wides = 0 AND noballs = 0
    GROUP BY striker_id, match_id, inning
),
PlayerInnings AS (
    SELECT 
        striker_id AS player_id,
        COUNT(*) AS innings,
        SUM(runs_in_innings) AS total_runs,
        SUM(wicket_taken) AS times_out
    FROM PlayerDismissals
    GROUP BY striker_id
),
DuckCounts AS (
    SELECT 
        striker_id AS player_id,
        COUNT(*) AS duck_count
    FROM PlayerDismissals
    WHERE runs_in_innings = 0 AND wicket_taken = 1
    GROUP BY striker_id
),
QualifiedPlayers AS (
    SELECT 
        pi.player_id,
        pi.innings,
        pi.total_runs,
        pi.times_out,
        dc.duck_count
    FROM PlayerInnings pi
    INNER JOIN DuckCounts dc ON pi.player_id = dc.player_id
    WHERE dc.duck_count = 3
),
StrikeRates AS (
    SELECT 
        qp.player_id,
        p.player_name,
        ROUND(
            CAST(qp.total_runs AS REAL) * 100.0 / 
            CAST(qp.times_out AS REAL), 
            2
        ) AS strike_rate
    FROM QualifiedPlayers qp
    INNER JOIN Players p ON qp.player_id = p.player_id
    WHERE qp.times_out > 0
)
SELECT 
    player_name,
    strike_rate
FROM StrikeRates
ORDER BY strike_rate DESC
LIMIT 1;

gold_sql: WITH PlayerInnings AS (SELECT match_id, striker_id, SUM(runs_scored) AS runs, MAX(CASE WHEN player_out_id = striker_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_out, SUM(runs_scored) AS total_runs, SUM(CASE WHEN wides = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS balls_faced FROM Deliveries GROUP BY match_id, striker_id), PlayerStats AS (SELECT striker_id, SUM(CASE WHEN runs = 0 AND is_out = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS duck_count, SUM(total_runs) AS career_runs, SUM(balls_faced) AS career_balls FROM PlayerInnings GROUP BY striker_id) SELECT p.player_name, (ps.career_runs * 100.0 / ps.career_balls) AS strike_rate FROM PlayerStats ps JOIN Players p ON ps.striker_id = p.player_id WHERE ps.duck_count = 3 AND ps.career_balls > 0 ORDER BY strike_rate DESC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
WITH PlayerWickets AS (
    SELECT 
        d.bowler_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT d.match_id) AS matches_played,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field') THEN d.delivery_id END) AS wickets_taken
    FROM Deliveries d
    WHERE d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY d.bowler_id
    HAVING wickets_taken = 3
),
PlayerStats AS (
    SELECT 
        pw.bowler_id AS player_id,

    FROM PlayerWickets pw

    GROUP BY pw.bowler_id, pw.matches_played
),
StrikeRates AS (
    SELECT 
        ps.player_id,
        ps.runs_scored,
        ps.balls_faced,
        CASE 
            WHEN ps.balls_faced > 0 THEN ROUND((ps.runs_scored * 100.0) / ps.balls_faced, 2)
            ELSE 0 
        END AS strike_rate
    FROM PlayerStats ps
    WHERE ps.balls_faced > 0
)

gold_sql: WITH PlayerInnings AS (SELECT match_id, striker_id, SUM(runs_scored) AS runs, MAX(CASE WHEN player_out_id = striker_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_out, SUM(runs_scored) AS total_runs, SUM(CASE WHEN wides = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS balls_faced FROM Deliveries GROUP BY match_id, striker_id), PlayerStats AS (SELECT striker_id, SUM(CASE WHEN runs = 0 AND is_out = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS duck_count, SUM(total_runs) AS career_runs, SUM(balls_faced) AS career_balls FROM PlayerInnings GROUP BY striker_id) SELECT p.player_name, (ps.career_runs * 100.0 / ps.career_balls) AS strike_rate FROM PlayerStats ps JOIN Players p ON ps.striker_id = p.player_id WHERE ps.duck_count = 3 AND ps.career_balls > 0 ORDER BY strike_rate DESC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
WITH BowlerWickets AS (
    SELECT 
        d.bowler_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT d.match_id) AS matches_played,
        SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL 
                  AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field') 
                 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_wickets
    FROM Deliveries d
    GROUP BY d.bowler_id
    HAVING total_wickets = 3
),
BowlerStats AS (
    SELECT 
        bw.bowler_id,
        bw.matches_played,
        bw.total_wickets,
        SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN d.runs_scored ELSE 0 END) AS total_runs,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 END) AS balls_faced
    FROM BowlerWickets bw
    JOIN Deliveries d ON bw.bowler_id = d.striker_id
    GROUP BY bw.bowler_id, bw.matches_played, bw.total_wickets
    HAVING balls_faced > 0
)
SELECT 
    p.player_name,
    ROUND((bs.total_runs * 100.0) / bs.balls_faced, 2) AS strike_rate
FROM BowlerStats bs
JOIN Players p ON bs.bowler_id = p.player_id
ORDER BY strike_rate DESC
LIMIT 1;

gold_sql: WITH PlayerInnings AS (SELECT match_id, striker_id, SUM(runs_scored) AS runs, MAX(CASE WHEN player_out_id = striker_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_out, SUM(runs_scored) AS total_runs, SUM(CASE WHEN wides = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS balls_faced FROM Deliveries GROUP BY match_id, striker_id), PlayerStats AS (SELECT striker_id, SUM(CASE WHEN runs = 0 AND is_out = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS duck_count, SUM(total_runs) AS career_runs, SUM(balls_faced) AS career_balls FROM PlayerInnings GROUP BY striker_id) SELECT p.player_name, (ps.career_runs * 100.0 / ps.career_balls) AS strike_rate FROM PlayerStats ps JOIN Players p ON ps.striker_id = p.player_id WHERE ps.duck_count = 3 AND ps.career_balls > 0 ORDER BY strike_rate DESC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
WITH PlayerDismissals AS (
    SELECT 
        d.striker_id,
        d.match_id,
        d.inning,
        COUNT(DISTINCT d.match_id || '|' || d.inning) AS innings_played,
        SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN d.runs_scored ELSE 0 END) AS runs,
        SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS balls_faced,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE 
            WHEN d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL 
            AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field')
            AND d.player_out_id = d.striker_id 
            THEN d.delivery_id 
        END) AS times_out
    FROM Deliveries d
    GROUP BY d.striker_id
),
DuckPlayers AS (
    SELECT 
        striker_id,
        runs,
        balls_faced,
        times_out,
        innings_played
    FROM PlayerDismissals
    WHERE times_out = 3
)
SELECT 
    p.player_name,
    ROUND(
        CASE 
            WHEN dp.balls_faced > 0 THEN (dp.runs * 100.0) / dp.balls_faced
            ELSE 0 
        END, 
        2
    ) AS strike_rate
FROM DuckPlayers dp
JOIN Players p ON dp.striker_id = p.player_id
WHERE dp.balls_faced > 0
ORDER BY strike_rate DESC
LIMIT 1;

question: Name the team that conceded the most extras, state the ground, opposition, and how many were wides.
gold_sql: SELECT d.bowling_team, m.venue, d.batting_team AS opposition, SUM(d.wides) AS total_wides FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id GROUP BY d.match_id, d.bowling_team, m.venue, d.batting_team ORDER BY SUM(d.extra_runs) DESC LIMIT 1;
gold_answer: ["('Czech Republic', 'Estonian National Cricket and Rugby Field', 'Estonia', 49)"]
generated_sql:
WITH TeamExtras AS (
    SELECT 
        d.bowling_team,
        m.venue,
        CASE 
            WHEN d.bowling_team = m.team1 THEN m.team2 
            ELSE m.team1 
        END AS opposition,
        SUM(d.wides) AS total_wides,
        SUM(d.extra_runs) AS total_extras
    FROM Deliveries d
    JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
    GROUP BY d.match_id, d.bowling_team
)
SELECT 
    bowling_team,
    venue,
    opposition,
    total_wides
FROM TeamExtras
WHERE total_extras = (SELECT MAX(total_extras) FROM TeamExtras)
ORDER BY total_wides DESC
LIMIT 1;

question: In the T20 season 2026, which bowler took 4 wickets while conceding just 7 runs, against which opposition, and what was his economy rate?
gold_sql: SELECT p.player_name, d.batting_team AS opposition, (SUM(d.runs_scored + d.wides + d.noballs) * 6.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS economy_rate FROM Players p JOIN Deliveries d ON p.player_id = d.bowler_id JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE m.season = '2026' GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name, d.match_id, d.batting_team HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id IS NOT NULL AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'retired out', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 4 AND SUM(d.runs_scored + d.wides + d.noballs) = 7;
generated_sql:

    SELECT 
        p.player_name,
        CASE 
            WHEN m.team1 = d.bowling_team THEN m.team2 
            ELSE m.team1

        COUNT(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 END) AS wickets,
        SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) AS runs_conceded,
        COUNT(DISTINCT d.match_id || '-' || d.inning || '-' || d.over_number) AS overs_bowled

    JOIN Players p ON d.bowler_id = p.player_id
    WHERE m.season = '2026'

    GROUP BY d.bowler_id, d.match_id
    HAVING wickets = 4 AND runs_conceded = 7
)

    player_name,
    opposition,
    ROUND(CAST(runs_conceded AS REAL) / overs_bowled, 2) AS economy_rate
FROM bowler_stats;

gold_sql: SELECT m.match_winner AS winning_team, CASE WHEN m.team1 = m.match_winner THEN m.team2 ELSE m.team1 END AS opposing_team, (SELECT SUM(runs_scored + extra_runs) + 1 FROM Deliveries d WHERE d.match_id = m.match_id AND d.inning = 1) AS target_score FROM Matches m WHERE m.result_margin = 1 AND m.result_type = 'runs';

WITH MatchTargets AS (
    SELECT 
        m.match_id,
        m.team1,
        m.team2,
        m.match_winner,
        CASE 
            WHEN m.match_winner = m.team1 THEN m.team2
            ELSE m.team1
        END AS opposing_team,
        CASE 
            WHEN m.toss_decision = 'bat' THEN 
                CASE 
                    WHEN m.toss_winner = m.team1 THEN 
                        (SELECT SUM(runs_scored + extra_runs) 
                         FROM Deliveries d 
                         WHERE d.match_id = m.match_id AND d.inning = 1 AND d.batting_team = m.team1)
                    ELSE 
                        (SELECT SUM(runs_scored + extra_runs) 
                         FROM Deliveries d 
                         WHERE d.match_id = m.match_id AND d.inning = 1 AND d.batting_team = m.team2)
                END
            ELSE 
                CASE 
                    WHEN m.toss_winner = m.team1 THEN 
                        (SELECT SUM(runs_scored + extra_runs) 
                         FROM Deliveries d 
                         WHERE d.match_id = m.match_id AND d.inning = 2 AND d.batting_team = m.team2)
                    ELSE 
                        (SELECT SUM(runs_scored + extra_runs) 
                         FROM Deliveries d 
                         WHERE d.match_id = m.match_id AND d.inning = 2 AND d.batting_team = m.team1)
                END
        END AS target_score
    FROM Matches m
    WHERE m.result_type = 'runs' AND m.result_margin = 1
)
SELECT 
    match_winner AS winning_team,
    opposing_team,
    target_score
FROM MatchTargets
WHERE target_score IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY winning_team, opposing_team;

question: उन खिलाड़ियों के नाम बताइए जिन्होंने टी20 विश्व कपों में एक से अधिक सबसे तेज़ शतक बनाए हैं, और शतकों की संख्या भी बताइए।
gold_sql: WITH CenturyInnings AS (SELECT match_id, striker_id, SUM(CASE WHEN wides = 0 AND noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS balls FROM Deliveries GROUP BY match_id, striker_id HAVING SUM(runs_scored) >= 100) SELECT p.player_name, COUNT(c.match_id) AS number_of_hundreds FROM CenturyInnings c JOIN Players p ON c.striker_id = p.player_id GROUP BY c.striker_id, p.player_name HAVING COUNT(c.match_id) > 1;

WITH FastestHundreds AS (
    SELECT 
        d.striker_id,
        m.match_id,
        m.season,
        d.inning,
        SUM(d.runs_scored) AS runs_in_innings,
        COUNT(DISTINCT d.match_id || '|' || d.inning) AS balls_faced

question: ఏ క్రీడాకార్లు బంగ్లాదేశ్ కి వ్యతిరేకంగా వేగవంతమైన శతకాలు కొట్టారు? వాళ్ళు ఎన్ని బంతులు ఎదుర్కున్నారు?
gold_sql: WITH CenturyInnings AS (SELECT match_id, striker_id, SUM(CASE WHEN wides = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS balls_faced FROM Deliveries WHERE bowling_team = 'Bangladesh' GROUP BY match_id, striker_id HAVING SUM(runs_scored) >= 100) SELECT p.player_name, c.balls_faced FROM CenturyInnings c JOIN Players p ON c.striker_id = p.player_id ORDER BY c.balls_faced ASC;
gold_answer: ["('DA Miller', 36)", "('Mohammad Haris', 46)", "('SV Samson', 47)", "('C Munro', 54)", "('RR Rossouw', 56)", "('BB McCullum', 58)", "('Ahmed Shehzad', 62)"]

WITH bangladesh_matches AS (
    SELECT match_id
    FROM Matches
    WHERE team1 = 'Bangladesh' OR team2 = 'Bangladesh'
),
fast_centuries AS (
    SELECT 
        striker_id,
        match_id,
        inning,
        SUM(runs_scored) AS runs,
        COUNT(*) AS balls_faced
    FROM Deliveries d
    WHERE match_id IN (SELECT match_id FROM bangladesh_matches)
        AND wides = 0 
        AND noballs = 0
    GROUP BY striker_id, match_id, inning
    HAVING SUM(runs_scored) >= 100

    p.player_name,
    MIN(fc.balls_faced) AS balls_faced

question: उन बल्लेबाज़ों के नाम बताइए जिन्होंने बांग्लादेश के खिलाफ सबसे तेज़ शतक बनाए और उनके द्वारा खेली गई गेंदें भी बताइए।
gold_sql: WITH CenturyInnings AS (SELECT match_id, striker_id, SUM(CASE WHEN wides = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS balls_faced FROM Deliveries WHERE bowling_team = 'Bangladesh' GROUP BY match_id, striker_id HAVING SUM(runs_scored) >= 100) SELECT p.player_name, c.balls_faced FROM CenturyInnings c JOIN Players p ON c.striker_id = p.player_id ORDER BY c.balls_faced ASC;
gold_answer: ["('DA Miller', 36)", "('Mohammad Haris', 46)", "('SV Samson', 47)", "('C Munro', 54)", "('RR Rossouw', 56)", "('BB McCullum', 58)", "('Ahmed Shehzad', 62)"]
generated_sql:
WITH BangladeshMatches AS (
    SELECT match_id 
    FROM Matches 
    WHERE team1 = 'Bangladesh' OR team2 = 'Bangladesh'
),
BatterRuns AS (
    SELECT 
        d.match_id,
        d.striker_id,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 END) AS balls_faced,
        SUM(d.runs_scored) AS runs_scored
    FROM Deliveries d
    INNER JOIN BangladeshMatches bm ON d.match_id = bm.match_id
    GROUP BY d.match_id, d.striker_id
    HAVING runs_scored >= 100
),

    FROM BatterRuns

)

    br.balls_faced
FROM FastestCenturies fc
INNER JOIN BatterRuns br ON fc.striker_id = br.striker_id AND fc.min_balls = br.balls_faced
INNER JOIN Players p ON fc.striker_id = p.player_id
ORDER BY br.balls_faced ASC;

question: Which match holds the record for the highest run rate, and what is that run rate?
gold_sql: SELECT m.team1, m.team2, (SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) * 6.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS run_rate FROM Matches m JOIN Deliveries d ON m.match_id = d.match_id GROUP BY m.match_id, m.team1, m.team2 ORDER BY run_rate DESC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
WITH MatchRuns AS (
    SELECT 
        m.match_id,
        m.team1,
        m.team2,
        SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) AS total_runs,
        COUNT(DISTINCT d.over_number) AS total_overs
    FROM Matches m
    JOIN Deliveries d ON m.match_id = d.match_id
    WHERE d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0
    GROUP BY m.match_id, m.team1, m.team2
),
MatchRunRates AS (
    SELECT 
        team1,
        team2,
        CASE 
            WHEN total_overs > 0 THEN ROUND(CAST(total_runs AS REAL) / total_overs, 2)
            ELSE 0
        END AS run_rate
    FROM MatchRuns
)
SELECT 
    team1,
    team2,
    MAX(run_rate) AS run_rate
FROM MatchRunRates;

question: Name the batsmen who scored fastest hundreds against Bangladesh and also report the balls faced by them
gold_sql: WITH CenturyInnings AS (SELECT match_id, striker_id, SUM(CASE WHEN wides = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS balls_faced FROM Deliveries WHERE bowling_team = 'Bangladesh' GROUP BY match_id, striker_id HAVING SUM(runs_scored) >= 100) SELECT p.player_name, c.balls_faced FROM CenturyInnings c JOIN Players p ON c.striker_id = p.player_id ORDER BY c.balls_faced ASC;
gold_answer: ["('DA Miller', 36)", "('Mohammad Haris', 46)", "('SV Samson', 47)", "('C Munro', 54)", "('RR Rossouw', 56)", "('BB McCullum', 58)", "('Ahmed Shehzad', 62)"]
generated_sql:
WITH FastestHundreds AS (
    SELECT 
        striker_id,
        match_id,
        inning,
        MIN(ball_seq) AS hundred_ball
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            striker_id,
            match_id,
            inning,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY striker_id, match_id, inning 
                ORDER BY over_number, ball_number
            ) AS ball_seq,
            SUM(runs_scored) OVER (
                PARTITION BY striker_id, match_id, inning 
                ORDER BY over_number, ball_number 
                ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
            ) AS cumulative_runs
        FROM Deliveries
        WHERE wides = 0 AND noballs = 0
    ) AS BallByBall
    WHERE cumulative_runs >= 100
    GROUP BY striker_id, match_id, inning
    HAVING MIN(ball_seq) = MIN(CASE WHEN cumulative_runs >= 100 THEN ball_seq END)
),
BangladeshMatches AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.match_id
    FROM Matches m
    WHERE m.team1 = 'Bangladesh' OR m.team2 = 'Bangladesh'
),
HundredsVsBangladesh AS (
    SELECT 
        fh.striker_id,
        fh.match_id,
        fh.inning,
        fh.hundred_ball AS balls_faced
    FROM FastestHundreds fh
    INNER JOIN BangladeshMatches bm ON fh.match_id = bm.match_id
)
SELECT 
    p.player_name,
    hv.balls_faced
FROM HundredsVsBangladesh hv
INNER JOIN Players p ON hv.striker_id = p.player_id
ORDER BY hv.balls_faced ASC;

question: What is the average number of balls bowled across the 15 shortest matches (by the balls bowled) ?
gold_sql: SELECT AVG(balls_bowled) FROM (SELECT match_id, SUM(CASE WHEN wides = 0 AND noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS balls_bowled FROM Deliveries GROUP BY match_id ORDER BY balls_bowled ASC LIMIT 15);
generated_sql:
WITH MatchBalls AS (
    SELECT 
        match_id,
        COUNT(*) AS balls_bowled
    FROM Deliveries
    WHERE wides = 0 AND noballs = 0
    GROUP BY match_id
),
ShortestMatches AS (
    SELECT 
        balls_bowled
    FROM MatchBalls
    ORDER BY balls_bowled ASC
    LIMIT 15
)
SELECT 
    AVG(balls_bowled) AS "AVG(balls_bowled)"

question: सबसे कम वाइड्स देते हुए सबसे अधिक नो-बॉल किस टीम ने फेंकी? विपक्षी टीम और नो-बॉल से वाइड्स का अनुपात भी बताइए।
gold_sql: SELECT bowling_team, batting_team AS opposing_team, (SUM(noballs) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(wides), 0)) AS nb_to_wide_ratio FROM Deliveries GROUP BY match_id, bowling_team, batting_team ORDER BY SUM(noballs) DESC, SUM(wides) ASC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:

    SELECT 
        d.bowling_team,
        d.batting_team AS opposing_team,
        SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_wides,
        SUM(CASE WHEN d.noballs > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_noballs
    FROM Deliveries d
    GROUP BY d.bowling_team, d.batting_team
),
RankedTeams AS (
    SELECT 
        bowling_team,
        opposing_team,

question: ఏ టీం అన్నిటికన్నా తక్కువ వైడ్లు ఇస్తూ అన్నిటికన్నా ఎక్కువ నో బాల్స సంపాదించింది? వ్యతిరేకమైన టీం మరియు నో బాల్స/వైడ్ల రేషియో రాయండి.
gold_sql: SELECT bowling_team, batting_team AS opposing_team, (SUM(noballs) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(wides), 0)) AS nb_to_wide_ratio FROM Deliveries GROUP BY match_id, bowling_team, batting_team ORDER BY SUM(noballs) DESC, SUM(wides) ASC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
WITH TeamWides AS (
    SELECT bowling_team, COUNT(*) AS wides
    FROM Deliveries
    WHERE wides > 0
    GROUP BY bowling_team
),
TeamNoBalls AS (
    SELECT bowling_team, COUNT(*) AS noballs
    FROM Deliveries
    WHERE noballs > 0
    GROUP BY bowling_team
),
TeamStats AS (
    SELECT 
        COALESCE(w.bowling_team, n.bowling_team) AS bowling_team,
        COALESCE(w.wides, 0) AS wides,
        COALESCE(n.noballs, 0) AS noballs
    FROM TeamWides w
    FULL OUTER JOIN TeamNoBalls n ON w.bowling_team = n.bowling_team
),
RankedTeams AS (
    SELECT 
        bowling_team,
        wides,
        noballs,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY wides ASC) AS wide_rank,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY noballs DESC) AS noball_rank
    FROM TeamStats
),
TargetTeam AS (
    SELECT bowling_team
    FROM RankedTeams
    WHERE wide_rank = 1 AND noball_rank = 1
    LIMIT 1
),
OpposingTeams AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT batting_team AS opposing_team
    FROM Deliveries d
    JOIN TargetTeam t ON d.bowling_team = t.bowling_team
),
FinalRatio AS (
    SELECT 
        t.bowling_team,
        o.opposing_team,
        CASE 
            WHEN COALESCE(ts.wides, 0) = 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE ROUND(CAST(COALESCE(ts.noballs, 0) AS REAL) / ts.wides, 2)
        END AS nb_to_wide_ratio
    FROM TargetTeam t
    CROSS JOIN OpposingTeams o
    LEFT JOIN TeamStats ts ON t.bowling_team = ts.bowling_team
)
SELECT 
    bowling_team,
    opposing_team,
    nb_to_wide_ratio
FROM FinalRatio;

question: In T20I career batting history, which Indian batter has the highest strike rate among all Indian players with 3000+ runs. Report the Strike rate, average, and total sixes?
gold_sql: SELECT p.player_name, (SUM(d.runs_scored) * 100.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS strike_rate, (SUM(d.runs_scored) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id = d.striker_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)) AS average, SUM(CASE WHEN d.runs_scored = 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_sixes FROM Deliveries d JOIN Players p ON d.striker_id = p.player_id WHERE d.batting_team = 'India' GROUP BY d.striker_id, p.player_name HAVING SUM(d.runs_scored) >= 3000 ORDER BY strike_rate DESC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
WITH IndianBatters AS (
    SELECT 
        p.player_id,
        p.player_name
    FROM Players p
    JOIN PlayerInMatch pim ON p.player_id = pim.player_id
    WHERE pim.team_name = 'India'
    GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pim.match_id) >= 1
),
BatterStats AS (
    SELECT 
        ib.player_id,
        ib.player_name,
        SUM(d.runs_scored) AS total_runs,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 END) AS balls_faced,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL AND d.player_out_id = ib.player_id THEN 1 END) AS times_out,
        SUM(CASE WHEN d.runs_scored = 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_sixes
    FROM IndianBatters ib
    JOIN Deliveries d ON ib.player_id = d.striker_id
    GROUP BY ib.player_id, ib.player_name
    HAVING total_runs >= 3000
)
SELECT 
    player_name,
    ROUND((total_runs * 100.0) / balls_faced, 2) AS strike_rate,
    ROUND(total_runs * 1.0 / NULLIF(times_out, 0), 2) AS average,
    total_sixes
FROM BatterStats
ORDER BY strike_rate DESC
LIMIT 1;

gold_sql: WITH POTM_Counts AS (SELECT player_of_match_id AS player_id, COUNT(*) AS potm_count FROM Matches WHERE player_of_match_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY player_of_match_id HAVING COUNT(*) = 14), Match_Counts AS (SELECT player_id, COUNT(*) AS matches_played FROM PlayerInMatch GROUP BY player_id) SELECT p.player_name, mc.matches_played, (pc.potm_count * 1.0 / mc.matches_played) AS award_to_match_ratio FROM POTM_Counts pc JOIN Match_Counts mc ON pc.player_id = mc.player_id JOIN Players p ON pc.player_id = p.player_id ORDER BY award_to_match_ratio DESC LIMIT 4;

        m.match_id,
        m.match_date,
        m.venue,
        m.city,
        m.team1,
        m.team2,
        m.match_winner,
        m.result_type,
        m.result_margin,
        d.batting_team,
        SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) AS total_runs
    FROM Matches m
    JOIN Deliveries d ON m.match_id = d.match_id
    WHERE m.season LIKE '%T20I%' 
      AND m.team1 LIKE '%China%' 
      AND m.team2 LIKE '%China%'
    GROUP BY m.match_id, d.batting_team
),
ChinaScores AS (
    SELECT 
        ms.match_id,
        ms.match_date,
        ms.venue,
        ms.city,
        ms.batting_team AS china_team,
        ms.total_runs AS china_score,
        CASE 
            WHEN ms.batting_team = ms.team1 THEN ms.team2
            ELSE ms.team1
        END AS opponent,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ms.venue, ms.city ORDER BY ms.match_date) AS rn
    FROM MatchScores ms
    WHERE ms.batting_team LIKE '%China%'
      AND ms.result_type = 'completed'
),
ConsecutiveLowScores AS (
    SELECT 
        cs1.match_id AS match1_id,
        cs1.match_date AS date1,
        cs1.venue AS venue1,
        cs1.city AS city1,
        cs1.china_score AS score1,
        cs1.opponent AS opponent1,
        cs2.match_id AS match2_id,
        cs2.match_date AS date2,
        cs2.venue AS venue2,
        cs2.city AS city2,
        cs2.china_score AS score2,
        cs2.opponent AS opponent2,
        cs1.rn
    FROM ChinaScores cs1

question: 14 POTM ਅਵਾਰਡਾਂ ਵਾਲੇ ਸਾਰੇ ਖਿਡਾਰੀਆਂ ਵਿੱਚੋਂ ਕਿਸਦੀ ਅਵਾਰਡ-ਤੋਂ-ਮੈਚ ਅਨੁਪਾਤ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵਧੀਆ ਹੈ — ਸਾਰੇ ਚਾਰ ਖਿਡਾਰੀਆਂ ਦੇ ਨਾਮ, ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੁਆਰਾ ਖੇਡੇ ਮੈਚ ਅਤੇ ਹਰੇਕ ਦੀ ਅਨੁਪਾਤ ਦੀ ਗਣਨਾ ਕਰੋ?

question: Which player has won 8 POTM awards in the fewest matches in T20I history — name his country, span, and award ratio?
gold_sql: WITH MatchStats AS (SELECT pim.player_id, MAX(pim.team_name) AS country, COUNT(pim.match_id) AS matches_played, MIN(m.match_date) || ' to ' || MAX(m.match_date) AS span FROM PlayerInMatch pim JOIN Matches m ON pim.match_id = m.match_id GROUP BY pim.player_id), POTMStats AS (SELECT player_of_match_id AS player_id, COUNT(*) AS potm_awards FROM Matches WHERE player_of_match_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY player_of_match_id HAVING COUNT(*) = 8) SELECT p.player_name, ms.country, ms.span, (ps.potm_awards * 1.0 / ms.matches_played) AS award_ratio FROM POTMStats ps JOIN MatchStats ms ON ps.player_id = ms.player_id JOIN Players p ON ps.player_id = p.player_id ORDER BY ms.matches_played ASC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
WITH PlayerAwards AS (
    SELECT 
        p.player_id,
        p.player_name,
        MIN(m.match_date) AS first_match,
        MAX(m.match_date) AS last_match,
        COUNT(DISTINCT m.match_id) AS total_matches,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m.player_of_match_id = p.player_id THEN m.match_id END) AS potm_count
    FROM Players p
    JOIN PlayerInMatch pim ON p.player_id = pim.player_id
    JOIN Matches m ON pim.match_id = m.match_id
    WHERE m.season LIKE '%T20I%'
    GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name
    HAVING potm_count = 8
),
RankedPlayers AS (
    SELECT 
        player_name,
        (SELECT team_name FROM PlayerInMatch pim2 
         JOIN Matches m2 ON pim2.match_id = m2.match_id 
         WHERE pim2.player_id = pa.player_id AND m2.season LIKE '%T20I%'
         GROUP BY pim2.team_name 
         ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1) AS country,
        first_match || ' - ' || last_match AS span,
        ROUND(CAST(potm_count AS REAL) / total_matches, 3) AS award_ratio,
        total_matches,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_matches ASC) AS rn
    FROM PlayerAwards pa
)
SELECT player_name, country, span, award_ratio
FROM RankedPlayers
WHERE rn = 1;

        p.player_name,
        MIN(m.match_date) AS first_match_date,
        MAX(m.match_date) AS last_match_date,
        COUNT(DISTINCT m.match_id) AS total_matches,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m.player_of_match_id = p.player_id THEN m.match_id END) AS potm_count
    FROM Players p
    LEFT JOIN PlayerInMatch pim ON p.player_id = pim.player_id
    LEFT JOIN Matches m ON pim.match_id = m.match_id
    WHERE m.stage = 'T20I'
    GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name
    HAVING potm_count >= 8
),

    FROM PlayerInMatch pim

    LIMIT 1
)

    ROUND(CAST(pa.potm_count AS REAL) / pa.total_matches, 3) AS award_ratio
FROM PlayerAwards pa

question: T20I ఇతిహాసలో ఏ క్రీడాకారుడు అన్నిటికన్నా తక్కువ మ్యాచులలో 8 'ప్లేయర్ ఆఫ్ తే మ్యాచ్' అవార్డ్లు గెలిచాడు? అతన దేశం, ఆడిన సంవత్సరాలు మరియు రేషియో రాయండి.
gold_sql: WITH MatchStats AS (SELECT pim.player_id, MAX(pim.team_name) AS country, COUNT(pim.match_id) AS matches_played, MIN(m.match_date) || ' to ' || MAX(m.match_date) AS span FROM PlayerInMatch pim JOIN Matches m ON pim.match_id = m.match_id GROUP BY pim.player_id), POTMStats AS (SELECT player_of_match_id AS player_id, COUNT(*) AS potm_awards FROM Matches WHERE player_of_match_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY player_of_match_id HAVING COUNT(*) = 8) SELECT p.player_name, ms.country, ms.span, (ps.potm_awards * 1.0 / ms.matches_played) AS award_ratio FROM POTMStats ps JOIN MatchStats ms ON ps.player_id = ms.player_id JOIN Players p ON ps.player_id = p.player_id ORDER BY ms.matches_played ASC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
WITH PlayerAwards AS (
    SELECT 
        p.player_id,
        p.player_name,
        COUNT(DISTINCT m.match_id) AS matches_played,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m.player_of_match_id = p.player_id THEN m.match_id END) AS awards_won
    FROM Players p
    JOIN PlayerInMatch pim ON p.player_id = pim.player_id
    JOIN Matches m ON pim.match_id = m.match_id
    WHERE m.season LIKE '%T20I%'
    GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name
    HAVING awards_won >= 8
),
MinMatches AS (
    SELECT MIN(matches_played) AS min_matches
    FROM PlayerAwards
)
SELECT 
    pa.player_name,
    (SELECT team_name FROM PlayerInMatch WHERE player_id = pa.player_id LIMIT 1) AS country,
    (SELECT MIN(season) || '-' || MAX(season) 
     FROM Matches m2 
     JOIN PlayerInMatch pim2 ON m2.match_id = pim2.match_id 
     WHERE pim2.player_id = pa.player_id AND m2.season LIKE '%T20I%') AS span,
    ROUND(CAST(pa.awards_won AS REAL) / pa.matches_played, 3) AS award_ratio
FROM PlayerAwards pa
JOIN MinMatches mm ON pa.matches_played = mm.min_matches
ORDER BY pa.awards_won DESC, award_ratio DESC
LIMIT 1;

),

    SELECT 
        m.match_id,

        m.team2,

question: Sahibzada Farhan ਨੇ 2026 ਐਡੀਸ਼ਨ ਵਿੱਚ ਦੋ T20 ਵਿਸ਼ਵ ਕੱਪ ਸੈਂਕੜੇ ਲਗਾਏ। ਦੋਵੇਂ ਵਿਰੋਧੀ ਟੀਮਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਖੇਡੀਆਂ ਗੇਂਦਾਂ ਦੀ ਗਿਣਤੀ ਦੱਸੋ?
gold_sql: SELECT d.bowling_team AS opponents, SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS balls_taken FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id JOIN Players p ON d.striker_id = p.player_id WHERE p.player_name = 'Sahibzada Farhan' AND m.match_date LIKE '%2026%' GROUP BY d.match_id, d.bowling_team HAVING SUM(d.runs_scored) >= 100;
generated_sql:
WITH SahibzadaFarhanMatches AS (
    SELECT 
        m.match_id,
        m.team1,
        m.team2,
        pim.team_name AS player_team
    FROM Matches m
    JOIN PlayerInMatch pim ON m.match_id = pim.match_id
    JOIN Players p ON pim.player_id = p.player_id
    WHERE m.season = '2026'
      AND m.stage = 'T20 World Cup'
      AND p.player_name = 'Sahibzada Farhan'
),
CenturyDeliveries AS (
    SELECT 
        d.match_id,
        d.striker_id,
        SUM(d.runs_scored) OVER (PARTITION BY d.match_id, d.striker_id ORDER BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.over_number, d.ball_number) AS running_total,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.match_id, d.striker_id ORDER BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.over_number, d.ball_number) AS ball_number_in_innings
    FROM Deliveries d
    JOIN Players p ON d.striker_id = p.player_id
    WHERE p.player_name = 'Sahibzada Farhan'
      AND d.match_id IN (SELECT match_id FROM SahibzadaFarhanMatches)
),
CenturyBalls AS (
    SELECT 
        match_id,
        MIN(ball_number_in_innings) AS balls_to_century
    FROM CenturyDeliveries
    WHERE running_total >= 100
    GROUP BY match_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1
)
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN sfm.player_team = sfm.team1 THEN sfm.team2
        ELSE sfm.team1
    END AS opponents,
    cb.balls_to_century AS balls_taken
FROM SahibzadaFarhanMatches sfm
JOIN CenturyBalls cb ON sfm.match_id = cb.match_id

question: Abhishek Sharma ਦੀ 2 ਸੈਂਕੜਿਆਂ ਵਾਲੇ ਸਾਰੇ ਖਿਡਾਰੀਆਂ ਵਿੱਚੋਂ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਕਰੀਅਰ SR ਹੈ। ਉਸਦੀ ਸਟ੍ਰਾਈਕ ਰੇਟ, ਸੈਂਕੜੇ, ਔਸਤ ਦੱਸੋ ਅਤੇ ਗਣਨਾ ਕਰੋ ਕਿ ਉਹ ਔਸਤਨ ਹਰ ਸੈਂਕੜੇ 'ਤੇ ਕਿੰਨੀਆਂ ਗੇਂਦਾਂ ਖੇਡਦਾ ਹੈ?
gold_sql: WITH BatterInnings AS (SELECT d.striker_id AS player_id, d.match_id, d.inning, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS runs_scored, SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS balls_faced, CASE WHEN SUM(d.runs_scored) >= 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_hundred FROM Deliveries d JOIN Players p ON d.striker_id = p.player_id WHERE p.player_name = 'Abhishek Sharma' GROUP BY d.striker_id, d.match_id, d.inning), CareerStats AS (SELECT player_id, SUM(runs_scored) AS total_runs, SUM(balls_faced) AS total_balls, SUM(is_hundred) AS total_hundreds FROM BatterInnings GROUP BY player_id), Dismissals AS (SELECT player_out_id AS player_id, COUNT(*) AS total_dismissals FROM Deliveries d JOIN Players p ON d.player_out_id = p.player_id WHERE p.player_name = 'Abhishek Sharma' GROUP BY d.player_out_id) SELECT p.player_name, (c.total_runs * 100.0 / NULLIF(c.total_balls, 0)) AS strike_rate, c.total_hundreds AS hundreds, (c.total_runs * 1.0 / NULLIF(d.total_dismissals, 0)) AS average, (c.total_balls * 1.0 / NULLIF(c.total_hundreds, 0)) AS balls_per_hundred FROM CareerStats c JOIN Players p ON c.player_id = p.player_id LEFT JOIN Dismissals d ON c.player_id = d.player_id;
generated_sql:
WITH PlayerStats AS (
    SELECT 
        p.player_id,
        p.player_name,
        SUM(d.runs_scored) AS total_runs,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 END) AS legal_balls_faced,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d.runs_scored >= 100 THEN d.match_id END) AS hundreds,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 END) AS times_out
    FROM Players p
    JOIN Deliveries d ON p.player_id = d.striker_id
    GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name
    HAVING hundreds >= 2

        ELSE NULL

        COUNT(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 END) AS balls_faced,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN d.runs_scored = 6 THEN 1 END) AS sixes,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d.runs_scored = 0 AND d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 AND d.extra_runs = 0 AND d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL AND d.player_out_id = p.player_id THEN d.match_id || '-' || CAST(d.inning AS TEXT) END) AS ducks
    FROM Deliveries d
    JOIN Players p ON d.striker_id = p.player_id
    JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
    WHERE m.season LIKE '%T20I%'
        AND p.player_name IN ('GJ Maxwell', 'RG Sharma')
    GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name
)
SELECT 
    player_name,
    innings_played,
    CASE 
        WHEN innings_played - ducks > 0 THEN ROUND(CAST(total_runs AS REAL) / (innings_played - ducks), 2)
        ELSE NULL 
    END AS average,
    CASE 
        WHEN balls_faced > 0 THEN ROUND(CAST(total_runs AS REAL) / balls_faced * 100, 2)
        ELSE NULL 
    END AS sr,
    sixes,
    ducks
FROM PlayerStats
ORDER BY player_name;

question: Abhishek Sharma has the highest career SR among all players with 2 hundreds . Give his strike rate, hundreds, average, and calculate how many balls he faces per hundred on average?
gold_sql: WITH BatterInnings AS (SELECT d.striker_id AS player_id, d.match_id, d.inning, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS runs_scored, SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS balls_faced, CASE WHEN SUM(d.runs_scored) >= 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_hundred FROM Deliveries d JOIN Players p ON d.striker_id = p.player_id WHERE p.player_name = 'Abhishek Sharma' GROUP BY d.striker_id, d.match_id, d.inning), CareerStats AS (SELECT player_id, SUM(runs_scored) AS total_runs, SUM(balls_faced) AS total_balls, SUM(is_hundred) AS total_hundreds FROM BatterInnings GROUP BY player_id), Dismissals AS (SELECT player_out_id AS player_id, COUNT(*) AS total_dismissals FROM Deliveries d JOIN Players p ON d.player_out_id = p.player_id WHERE p.player_name = 'Abhishek Sharma' GROUP BY d.player_out_id) SELECT p.player_name, (c.total_runs * 100.0 / NULLIF(c.total_balls, 0)) AS strike_rate, c.total_hundreds AS hundreds, (c.total_runs * 1.0 / NULLIF(d.total_dismissals, 0)) AS average, (c.total_balls * 1.0 / NULLIF(c.total_hundreds, 0)) AS balls_per_hundred FROM CareerStats c JOIN Players p ON c.player_id = p.player_id LEFT JOIN Dismissals d ON c.player_id = d.player_id;
generated_sql:
WITH PlayerStats AS (
    SELECT 
        p.player_id,
        p.player_name,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE 
            WHEN d.runs_scored >= 100

        END) AS hundreds,
        SUM(CASE 
            WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 
            THEN d.runs_scored 
            ELSE 0 
        END) AS total_runs,
        SUM(CASE 
            WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 
            THEN 1 
            ELSE 0 
        END) AS balls_faced,
        SUM(CASE 
            WHEN d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL 
            AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field')
            AND d.player_out_id = d.striker_id 
            THEN 1 
            ELSE 0 
        END) AS times_out
    FROM Players p
    LEFT JOIN Deliveries d ON p.player_id = d.striker_id
    GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name
    HAVING hundreds = 2
),

            WHEN times_out > 0

        d.inning AS innings_number,
        COUNT(DISTINCT d.delivery_id) AS total_wickets,

gold_answer: ["('Kuwait', 'Asian Institute of Technology Ground', '2019-02-27')", "('Germany', 'Desert Springs Cricket Ground, Almeria', '2021-09-11')", "('Sri Lanka', 'Zhejiang University of Technology Cricket Field', '2023-09-25')", "('Germany', 'Bayer Uerdingen Cricket Ground', '2024-07-28')"]

        d.match_id,
        d.bowling_team AS fielding_team,
        d.batting_team AS batting_team,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d.wicket_type = 'stumped' THEN d.player_out_id END) AS stumping_count,
        SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) AS total_runs
    FROM Deliveries d
    WHERE d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY d.match_id, d.bowling_team, d.batting_team
),
FilteredMatches AS (
    SELECT 
        tsw.match_id,
        tsw.fielding_team AS team_suffered_stumping,
        tsw.batting_team AS opposition,

        tsw.total_runs

    WHERE tsw.stumping_count = 1 
      AND tsw.total_runs = 116
),
WinningMatches AS (
    SELECT 
        fm.match_id,

        fm.opposition,
        fm.stumping_count,

        m.venue,

    match_date
FROM WinningMatches;

question: T20I ਇਤਿਹਾਸ ਵਿੱਚ ਦੋ ਟੀਮਾਂ ਨੇ ਇੱਕੋ ਪਾਰੀ ਵਿੱਚ 4 ਸਟੰਪਿੰਗ ਝੱਲੀਆਂ — ਦੋਵੇਂ ਟੀਮਾਂ, ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੇ ਸਕੋਰ ਅਤੇ ਵਿਰੋਧੀ ਟੀਮਾਂ ਦੱਸੋ?
gold_sql: SELECT d.batting_team, SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) AS score, d.bowling_team AS opposition FROM Deliveries d GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.batting_team, d.bowling_team HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type = 'stumped' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 4;
generated_sql:
WITH StumpingDeliveries AS (
    SELECT 
        d.match_id,
        d.inning,
        d.batting_team,
        d.bowling_team,
        d.wicket_type,
        d.player_out_id
    FROM Deliveries d
    WHERE d.wicket_type = 'stumped'
),
TeamStumpingCounts AS (
    SELECT 
        sd.match_id,
        sd.inning,
        sd.batting_team,
        COUNT(*) AS stumping_count
    FROM StumpingDeliveries sd
    GROUP BY sd.match_id, sd.inning, sd.batting_team
    HAVING COUNT(*) = 4
),
MatchScores AS (
    SELECT 
        d.match_id,
        d.inning,
        d.batting_team,
        SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) AS total_runs
    FROM Deliveries d
    GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.batting_team
)
SELECT 
    tsc.batting_team AS batting_team,
    ms.total_runs AS score,
    CASE 
        WHEN tsc.batting_team = m.team1 THEN m.team2
        ELSE m.team1
    END AS opposition
FROM TeamStumpingCounts tsc
JOIN MatchScores ms ON tsc.match_id = ms.match_id 
    AND tsc.inning = ms.inning 
    AND tsc.batting_team = ms.batting_team
JOIN Matches m ON tsc.match_id = m.match_id;

question: ఆస్ట్రేలియా 3 స్టంపింగ్‌లతో 197/7 స్కోరు చేసి గెలిచింది. ప్రత్యర్థి జట్టు, వేదిక, తేదీని పేర్కొని, వారి వికెట్లలో స్టంపింగ్‌ల శాతం ఎంత అని లెక్కించండి.
gold_sql: SELECT d.bowling_team AS opposition, m.venue, m.match_date, d.inning AS innings_number, (SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type = 'stumped' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)) AS stumping_percentage FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE d.batting_team = 'Australia' AND m.match_winner = 'Australia' GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.bowling_team, m.venue, m.match_date HAVING SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) = 197 AND SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 7 AND SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type = 'stumped' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 3;
generated_sql:
WITH MatchDetails AS (
    SELECT 
        m.match_id,
        m.venue,
        m.match_date,
        CASE 
            WHEN m.team1 = 'Australia' THEN m.team2 
            ELSE m.team1 
        END AS opposition,
        CASE 
            WHEN m.match_winner = 'Australia' THEN 1 
            ELSE 2 
        END AS australia_innings
    FROM Matches m
    WHERE m.match_winner = 'Australia' 
      AND m.result_margin = 3 
      AND m.result_type = 'wickets'
      AND (
          (m.team1 = 'Australia' AND m.result_margin = 3 AND m.result_type = 'wickets') OR
          (m.team2 = 'Australia' AND m.result_margin = 3 AND m.result_type = 'wickets')
      )
),
AustraliaWickets AS (
    SELECT 
        md.match_id,
        md.opposition,
        md.venue,
        md.match_date,
        d.inning AS innings_number,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type = 'stumped' THEN 1 END) AS stumping_count,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL 
                   AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field') 
                   THEN 1 END) AS total_bowler_wickets
    FROM MatchDetails md
    JOIN Deliveries d ON md.match_id = d.match_id
    WHERE d.inning != md.australia_innings
      AND d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL
      AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field')
    GROUP BY md.match_id, md.opposition, md.venue, md.match_date, d.inning
    HAVING total_bowler_wickets = 7
)
SELECT 
    opposition,
    venue,
    match_date,
    innings_number,
    ROUND(
        CASE 
            WHEN total_bowler_wickets > 0 
            THEN (stumping_count * 100.0 / total_bowler_wickets)
            ELSE 0 
        END, 2
    ) AS stumping_percentage
FROM AustraliaWickets
WHERE stumping_count = 3;

question: Australia ਨੇ 3 ਸਟੰਪਿੰਗ ਦੇ ਬਾਵਜੂਦ 197/7 ਬਣਾਏ ਅਤੇ ਫਿਰ ਵੀ ਜਿੱਤਿਆ। ਵਿਰੋਧੀ ਟੀਮ, ਮੈਦਾਨ, ਤਾਰੀਖ ਦੱਸੋ ਅਤੇ ਗਣਨਾ ਕਰੋ ਕਿ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੀਆਂ ਕਿੰਨੀ ਪ੍ਰਤੀਸ਼ਤ ਵਿਕਟਾਂ ਸਟੰਪਿੰਗ ਸਨ?
gold_sql: SELECT d.bowling_team AS opposition, m.venue, m.match_date, d.inning AS innings_number, (SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type = 'stumped' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)) AS stumping_percentage FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE d.batting_team = 'Australia' AND m.match_winner = 'Australia' GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.bowling_team, m.venue, m.match_date HAVING SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) = 197 AND SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 7 AND SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type = 'stumped' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 3;
generated_sql:
WITH StumpingWickets AS (
    SELECT 
        d.match_id,
        d.inning AS innings_number,
        COUNT(*) AS stumping_count
    FROM Deliveries d
    WHERE d.wicket_type = 'stumped'
    GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning
),
TeamWickets AS (
    SELECT 
        d.match_id,
        d.inning AS innings_number,
        COUNT(*) AS total_wickets
    FROM Deliveries d
    WHERE d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL 
      AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field')
    GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning
),
AustraliaMatches AS (
    SELECT 
        m.match_id,
        m.match_date,
        m.venue,
        CASE 
            WHEN m.team1 = 'Australia' THEN m.team2
            ELSE m.team1
        END AS opposition,
        pim.team_name,
        d.inning AS innings_number
    FROM Matches m
    JOIN PlayerInMatch pim ON m.match_id = pim.match_id
    JOIN Deliveries d ON m.match_id = d.match_id
    WHERE pim.team_name = 'Australia'
    GROUP BY m.match_id, d.inning
)
SELECT 
    am.opposition,
    am.venue,
    am.match_date,
    am.innings_number,
    ROUND(
        COALESCE(sw.stumping_count, 0) * 100.0 / 
        NULLIF(tw.total_wickets, 0), 
        2
    ) AS stumping_percentage
FROM AustraliaMatches am
LEFT JOIN StumpingWickets sw ON am.match_id = sw.match_id AND am.innings_number = sw.innings_number
LEFT JOIN TeamWickets tw ON am.match_id = tw.match_id AND am.innings_number = tw.innings_number
WHERE sw.stumping_count >= 3
  AND am.team_name = 'Australia'
ORDER BY am.match_date DESC;

question: List all players who batted in Innings 2 and scored 70+ runs on debut. Give names, teams, and scores.
gold_sql: WITH PlayerDebut AS (SELECT player_id, MIN(match_date) as debut_date FROM PlayerInMatch pim JOIN Matches m ON pim.match_id = m.match_id GROUP BY player_id), DebutMatches AS (SELECT pim.player_id, pim.match_id, pim.team_name FROM PlayerInMatch pim JOIN Matches m ON pim.match_id = m.match_id JOIN PlayerDebut pd ON pim.player_id = pd.player_id AND m.match_date = pd.debut_date) SELECT p.player_name, dm.team_name, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS score FROM Deliveries d JOIN DebutMatches dm ON d.striker_id = dm.player_id AND d.match_id = dm.match_id JOIN Players p ON dm.player_id = p.player_id WHERE d.inning = 2 GROUP BY d.match_id, d.striker_id, p.player_name, dm.team_name HAVING SUM(d.runs_scored) >= 70 LIMIT 5;
