question: उन सभी खिलाड़ियों की सूची दीजिए जिन्होंने दूसरी पारी में बल्लेबाज़ी करते हुए डेब्यू पर 70 या उससे अधिक रन बनाए। नाम, टीम और स्कोर बताइए।
gold_sql: WITH PlayerDebut AS (SELECT player_id, MIN(match_date) as debut_date FROM PlayerInMatch pim JOIN Matches m ON pim.match_id = m.match_id GROUP BY player_id), DebutMatches AS (SELECT pim.player_id, pim.match_id, pim.team_name FROM PlayerInMatch pim JOIN Matches m ON pim.match_id = m.match_id JOIN PlayerDebut pd ON pim.player_id = pd.player_id AND m.match_date = pd.debut_date) SELECT p.player_name, dm.team_name, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS score FROM Deliveries d JOIN DebutMatches dm ON d.striker_id = dm.player_id AND d.match_id = dm.match_id JOIN Players p ON dm.player_id = p.player_id WHERE d.inning = 2 GROUP BY d.match_id, d.striker_id, p.player_name, dm.team_name HAVING SUM(d.runs_scored) >= 70 LIMIT 5;
gold_answer: ["('SC Taylor', 'England', 76)", "('RR Rossouw', 'South Africa', 78)", "('JM Watkin', 'New Zealand', 77)", "('Aziz Mohammad', 'Belgium', 72)", "('PV Vuniwaqa', 'Fiji', 72)"]
generated_sql:
WITH DebutMatches AS (
    SELECT 
        pim.player_id,
        pim.team_name,
        MIN(m.match_date) AS debut_date
    FROM PlayerInMatch pim
    JOIN Matches m ON pim.match_id = m.match_id
    GROUP BY pim.player_id, pim.team_name
),
DebutMatchInfo AS (
    SELECT 
        dm.player_id,
        dm.team_name,
        m.match_id
    FROM DebutMatches dm
    JOIN Matches m ON dm.debut_date = m.match_date
    JOIN PlayerInMatch pim ON m.match_id = pim.match_id AND dm.player_id = pim.player_id
),
InningScores AS (
    SELECT 
        dmi.player_id,
        dmi.team_name,
        dmi.match_id,
        d.inning,
        SUM(d.runs_scored) AS score
    FROM DebutMatchInfo dmi
    JOIN Deliveries d ON dmi.match_id = d.match_id AND dmi.player_id = d.striker_id
    WHERE d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0
    GROUP BY dmi.player_id, dmi.team_name, dmi.match_id, d.inning
)
SELECT 
    p.player_name,
    ins.team_name,
    ins.score
FROM InningScores ins
JOIN Players p ON ins.player_id = p.player_id
WHERE ins.inning = 2 AND ins.score >= 70
ORDER BY ins.score DESC;

question: Spain have won two T20I matches by 1 wicket in their history. Name both matches with targets, opposition, grounds, and dates.
gold_sql: SELECT m.match_date, m.venue AS ground, CASE WHEN m.team1 = 'Spain' THEN m.team2 ELSE m.team1 END AS opposition, (SELECT SUM(runs_scored + extra_runs) FROM Deliveries d2 WHERE d2.match_id = m.match_id AND d2.inning = 1) + 1 AS target FROM Matches m WHERE m.match_winner = 'Spain' AND m.result_type = 'wickets' AND m.result_margin = 1;
gold_answer: ["('2021-09-11', 'Desert Springs Cricket Ground, Almeria', 'Germany', 120)", "('2024-04-14', 'La Manga Club Top Ground', 'Jersey', 142)"]
generated_sql:
WITH MatchTargets AS (
    SELECT 
        m.match_id,
        m.match_date,
        m.venue AS ground,
        CASE 
            WHEN m.team1 = 'Spain' THEN m.team2 
            ELSE m.team1 
        END AS opposition,
        SUM(CASE 
            WHEN d.inning = 1 THEN d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs 
            ELSE 0 
        END) AS target
    FROM Matches m
    JOIN Deliveries d ON m.match_id = d.match_id
    WHERE m.match_winner = 'Spain' 
      AND m.result_type = 'wickets' 
      AND m.result_margin = 1
    GROUP BY m.match_id, m.match_date, m.venue, opposition
    HAVING target > 0
)
SELECT 
    match_date,
    ground,
    opposition,
    target
FROM MatchTargets
ORDER BY match_date;
generated_answer: [('2021-09-11', 'Desert Springs Cricket Ground, Almeria', 'Germany', 119), ('2024-04-14', 'La Manga Club Top Ground', 'Jersey', 141)]

question: ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਸਾਰੇ ਖਿਡਾਰੀਆਂ ਦੀ ਸੂਚੀ ਬਣਾਓ ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੇ ਆਪਣੇ ਡੈਬਿਊ 'ਤੇ ਦੂਜੀ ਪਾਰੀ ਵਿੱਚ ਬੱਲੇਬਾਜ਼ੀ ਕਰਦੇ ਹੋਏ 70 ਜਾਂ ਵੱਧ ਰਨ ਬਣਾਏ। ਨਾਮ, ਟੀਮਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਸਕੋਰ ਦੱਸੋ?
gold_sql: WITH PlayerDebut AS (SELECT player_id, MIN(match_date) as debut_date FROM PlayerInMatch pim JOIN Matches m ON pim.match_id = m.match_id GROUP BY player_id), DebutMatches AS (SELECT pim.player_id, pim.match_id, pim.team_name FROM PlayerInMatch pim JOIN Matches m ON pim.match_id = m.match_id JOIN PlayerDebut pd ON pim.player_id = pd.player_id AND m.match_date = pd.debut_date) SELECT p.player_name, dm.team_name, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS score FROM Deliveries d JOIN DebutMatches dm ON d.striker_id = dm.player_id AND d.match_id = dm.match_id JOIN Players p ON dm.player_id = p.player_id WHERE d.inning = 2 GROUP BY d.match_id, d.striker_id, p.player_name, dm.team_name HAVING SUM(d.runs_scored) >= 70 LIMIT 5;
gold_answer: ["('SC Taylor', 'England', 76)", "('RR Rossouw', 'South Africa', 78)", "('JM Watkin', 'New Zealand', 77)", "('Aziz Mohammad', 'Belgium', 72)", "('PV Vuniwaqa', 'Fiji', 72)"]
generated_sql:
WITH PlayerDebut AS (
    SELECT 
        pim.player_id,
        pim.team_name,
        MIN(m.match_date) AS debut_date
    FROM PlayerInMatch pim
    JOIN Matches m ON pim.match_id = m.match_id
    GROUP BY pim.player_id, pim.team_name
),
DebutMatch AS (
    SELECT 
        pd.player_id,
        pd.team_name,
        m.match_id
    FROM PlayerDebut pd
    JOIN Matches m ON pd.debut_date = m.match_date
    JOIN PlayerInMatch pim ON m.match_id = pim.match_id AND pd.player_id = pim.player_id AND pd.team_name = pim.team_name
),
DebutInnings AS (
    SELECT 
        dm.player_id,
        dm.team_name,
        dm.match_id,
        d.inning
    FROM DebutMatch dm
    JOIN Deliveries d ON dm.match_id = d.match_id AND dm.player_id = d.striker_id
    GROUP BY dm.player_id, dm.team_name, dm.match_id, d.inning
    HAVING MIN(d.inning) = 2
),
DebutScores AS (
    SELECT 
        di.player_id,
        di.team_name,
        di.match_id,
        SUM(d.runs_scored) AS score
    FROM DebutInnings di
    JOIN Deliveries d ON di.match_id = d.match_id AND di.inning = d.inning AND di.player_id = d.striker_id
    GROUP BY di.player_id, di.team_name, di.match_id
    HAVING score >= 70
)
SELECT 
    p.player_name,
    ds.team_name,
    ds.score
FROM DebutScores ds
JOIN Players p ON ds.player_id = p.player_id;

question: రెండవ ఇన్నింగ్స్‌లో బ్యాటింగ్ చేసి, తమ అరంగేట్రంలోనే 70కి పైగా పరుగులు సాధించిన ఆటగాళ్లందరి పేర్లను, జట్లను, స్కోర్లను తెలపండి

WITH SecondInningScores AS (
    SELECT 
        d.striker_id,
        pim.team_name,
        SUM(d.runs_scored) AS score
    FROM Deliveries d
    JOIN PlayerInMatch pim ON d.match_id = pim.match_id AND d.striker_id = pim.player_id
    WHERE d.inning = 2
    GROUP BY d.match_id, d.striker_id, pim.team_name
    HAVING score > 70
),
PlayerDebutMatches AS (
    SELECT 
        player_id,
        MIN(match_id) AS debut_match_id
    FROM PlayerInMatch

)

    pl.player_name,
    sis.team_name,
    sis.score

JOIN PlayerDebutMatches pdm ON sis.striker_id = pdm.player_id

question: स्पेन ने अपने इतिहास में 1 विकेट से दो टी20I मैच जीते हैं। दोनों मैचों के लक्ष्य, विपक्षी टीम, मैदान और तारीखें बताइए।
gold_sql: SELECT m.match_date, m.venue AS ground, CASE WHEN m.team1 = 'Spain' THEN m.team2 ELSE m.team1 END AS opposition, (SELECT SUM(runs_scored + extra_runs) FROM Deliveries d2 WHERE d2.match_id = m.match_id AND d2.inning = 1) + 1 AS target FROM Matches m WHERE m.match_winner = 'Spain' AND m.result_type = 'wickets' AND m.result_margin = 1;
gold_answer: ["('2021-09-11', 'Desert Springs Cricket Ground, Almeria', 'Germany', 120)", "('2024-04-14', 'La Manga Club Top Ground', 'Jersey', 142)"]
generated_sql:
WITH SpainWins AS (
    SELECT 
        m.match_id,
        m.match_date,
        m.venue AS ground,
        CASE 
            WHEN m.team1 = 'Spain' THEN m.team2 
            ELSE m.team1 
        END AS opposition,
        m.result_margin
    FROM Matches m
    WHERE m.match_winner = 'Spain' 
      AND m.result_type = 'wickets' 
      AND m.result_margin = 1
),
InningsTotals AS (
    SELECT 
        d.match_id,
        d.batting_team,
        SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) AS total_runs
    FROM Deliveries d
    WHERE d.inning = 1
    GROUP BY d.match_id, d.batting_team
)
SELECT 
    sw.match_date,
    sw.ground,
    sw.opposition,
    it.total_runs + 1 AS target
FROM SpainWins sw
JOIN InningsTotals it ON sw.match_id = it.match_id 
    AND it.batting_team = sw.opposition
ORDER BY sw.match_date;

        m.match_winner

        AND m.result_margin = 1 
        AND (m.team1 = 'Spain' OR m.team2 = 'Spain')

    opposition,
    target

question: Among the top 5 run-scorers in T20I history, give the strike rate , the average runs per innings for each, and rank them by batting average.
gold_sql: WITH BatterStats AS (SELECT d.striker_id, p.player_name, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS total_runs, SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS balls_faced, COUNT(DISTINCT d.match_id) AS innings_played FROM Deliveries d JOIN Players p ON d.striker_id = p.player_id GROUP BY d.striker_id, p.player_name), Top5Batters AS (SELECT * FROM BatterStats ORDER BY total_runs DESC LIMIT 5), Dismissals AS (SELECT player_out_id AS player_id, COUNT(*) AS times_out FROM Deliveries WHERE player_out_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY player_out_id) SELECT t.player_name, (t.total_runs * 100.0 / NULLIF(t.balls_faced, 0)) AS strike_rate, (t.total_runs * 1.0 / NULLIF(t.innings_played, 0)) AS avg_runs_per_innings, (t.total_runs * 1.0 / NULLIF(d.times_out, 0)) AS batting_average FROM Top5Batters t LEFT JOIN Dismissals d ON t.striker_id = d.player_id ORDER BY batting_average DESC;
generated_sql:
WITH Top5RunScorers AS (
    SELECT 
        p.player_id,
        p.player_name,
        SUM(d.runs_scored) AS total_runs,
        COUNT(DISTINCT d.match_id || '-' || d.inning) AS innings_played,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field') THEN d.striker_id END) AS times_out
    FROM Players p
    JOIN Deliveries d ON p.player_id = d.striker_id
    JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
    WHERE m.season LIKE '%T20I%'
    GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name
    ORDER BY total_runs DESC
    LIMIT 5
),
BallsFaced AS (
    SELECT 
        d.striker_id,
        COUNT(*) AS balls_faced
    FROM Deliveries d
    JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
    WHERE m.season LIKE '%T20I%'
      AND d.wides = 0 
      AND d.noballs = 0
    GROUP BY d.striker_id
)
SELECT 
    t.player_name,
    ROUND((t.total_runs * 100.0) / b.balls_faced, 2) AS strike_rate,
    ROUND(t.total_runs * 1.0 / t.innings_played, 2) AS avg_runs_per_innings,
    ROUND(CASE 
        WHEN t.times_out > 0 THEN t.total_runs * 1.0 / t.times_out 
        ELSE NULL 
    END, 2) AS batting_average
FROM Top5RunScorers t
LEFT JOIN BallsFaced b ON t.player_id = b.striker_id

gold_sql: WITH BatterStats AS (SELECT d.striker_id, p.player_name, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS total_runs, SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS balls_faced, COUNT(DISTINCT d.match_id) AS innings_played FROM Deliveries d JOIN Players p ON d.striker_id = p.player_id GROUP BY d.striker_id, p.player_name), Top5Batters AS (SELECT * FROM BatterStats ORDER BY total_runs DESC LIMIT 5), Dismissals AS (SELECT player_out_id AS player_id, COUNT(*) AS times_out FROM Deliveries WHERE player_out_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY player_out_id) SELECT t.player_name, (t.total_runs * 100.0 / NULLIF(t.balls_faced, 0)) AS strike_rate, (t.total_runs * 1.0 / NULLIF(t.innings_played, 0)) AS avg_runs_per_innings, (t.total_runs * 1.0 / NULLIF(d.times_out, 0)) AS batting_average FROM Top5Batters t LEFT JOIN Dismissals d ON t.striker_id = d.player_id ORDER BY batting_average DESC;

        p.player_id,

question: गेंदों के आधार पर टी20I इतिहास की सबसे छोटी पूर्ण पारी कौन-सी है? टीम, स्कोर, गेंदें, रन रेट और विपक्षी टीम बताइए।
gold_sql: SELECT d.batting_team AS team, SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) AS score, SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS balls, (SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) * 6.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)) AS run_rate, d.bowling_team AS opposition FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE m.result_type NOT IN ('no result', 'abandoned') GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.batting_team, d.bowling_team ORDER BY balls ASC LIMIT 1;

WITH TeamInnings AS (
    SELECT 
        m.match_id,
        d.batting_team AS team,
        d.inning,
        SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) AS total_runs,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 END) AS legal_balls,
        MAX(CASE WHEN d.batting_team = m.team1 THEN m.team2 ELSE m.team1 END) AS opposition
    FROM Matches m
    JOIN Deliveries d ON m.match_id = d.match_id
    WHERE m.season LIKE '%T20I%'
    GROUP BY m.match_id, d.batting_team, d.inning
    HAVING legal_balls > 0
),
CompletedInnings AS (
    SELECT 
        ti.*,
        (ti.total_runs * 100.0 / ti.legal_balls) AS run_rate
    FROM TeamInnings ti
    WHERE ti.inning IN (1, 2)
    AND ti.total_runs IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
    team,
    total_runs AS score,
    legal_balls AS balls,
    ROUND(run_rate, 2) AS run_rate,
    opposition
FROM CompletedInnings
ORDER BY balls ASC, run_rate DESC
LIMIT 1;

question: ਗੇਂਦਾਂ ਦੇ ਹਿਸਾਬ ਨਾਲ T20I ਇਤਿਹਾਸ ਵਿੱਚ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਛੋਟੀ ਪੂਰੀ ਹੋਈ ਪਾਰੀ ਕਿਹੜੀ ਹੈ? ਟੀਮ, ਸਕੋਰ, ਗੇਂਦਾਂ, ਰਨ ਰੇਟ ਅਤੇ ਵਿਰੋਧੀ ਟੀਮ ਦੱਸੋ?
gold_sql: SELECT d.batting_team AS team, SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) AS score, SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS balls, (SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) * 6.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)) AS run_rate, d.bowling_team AS opposition FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE m.result_type NOT IN ('no result', 'abandoned') GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.batting_team, d.bowling_team ORDER BY balls ASC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
WITH TeamInnings AS (
    SELECT 
        m.match_id,
        d.batting_team AS team,
        d.inning,
        SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) AS total_runs,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 END) AS legal_balls,
        MAX(CASE WHEN d.batting_team = m.team1 THEN m.team2 ELSE m.team1 END) AS opposition,
        m.match_date
    FROM Deliveries d
    JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
    WHERE m.season LIKE '%T20%' OR m.season LIKE '%T20I%'
    GROUP BY m.match_id, d.batting_team, d.inning
    HAVING total_runs >= MAX(
        CASE WHEN d.batting_team = m.team1 THEN 
            (SELECT SUM(d2.runs_scored + d2.extra_runs) 
             FROM Deliveries d2 
             WHERE d2.match_id = m.match_id AND d2.batting_team = m.team2)
        ELSE 
            (SELECT SUM(d3.runs_scored + d3.extra_runs) 
             FROM Deliveries d3 
             WHERE d3.match_id = m.match_id AND d3.batting_team = m.team1)
        END
    )
),
RankedInnings AS (
    SELECT 
        team,
        total_runs AS score,
        legal_balls AS balls,
        ROUND((total_runs * 1.0 / legal_balls) * 6, 2) AS run_rate,
        opposition,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY legal_balls ASC, total_runs ASC) AS rank
    FROM TeamInnings
    WHERE legal_balls > 0
)
SELECT 
    team,
    score,
    balls,
    run_rate,
    opposition
FROM RankedInnings
WHERE rank = 1
ORDER BY balls ASC, score ASC;

question: What is the shortest completed innings in T20I history by balls? Give the team, score, balls, run rate, opposition.
gold_sql: SELECT d.batting_team AS team, SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) AS score, SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS balls, (SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) * 6.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)) AS run_rate, d.bowling_team AS opposition FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE m.result_type NOT IN ('no result', 'abandoned') GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.batting_team, d.bowling_team ORDER BY balls ASC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
WITH CompletedInnings AS (
    SELECT 
        d.match_id,
        d.inning,
        d.batting_team AS team,
        SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) AS total_runs,
        COUNT(*) AS balls_bowled,
        m.team1,
        m.team2,
        CASE 
            WHEN d.batting_team = m.team1 THEN m.team2 
            ELSE m.team1 
        END AS opposition
    FROM Deliveries d
    JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
    WHERE d.inning IN (1, 2)
    GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.batting_team
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 20
),
InningsWickets AS (
    SELECT 
        d.match_id,
        d.inning,
        COUNT(*) AS wickets_fallen
    FROM Deliveries d
    WHERE d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL 
      AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field')
    GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning
),
ShortestInnings AS (
    SELECT 
        ci.match_id,
        ci.inning,
        ci.team,
        ci.total_runs AS score,
        ci.balls_bowled AS balls,
        ROUND((ci.total_runs * 1.0 / ci.balls_bowled) * 6, 2) AS run_rate,
        ci.opposition,
        COALESCE(iw.wickets_fallen, 0) AS wickets_fallen
    FROM CompletedInnings ci
    LEFT JOIN InningsWickets iw ON ci.match_id = iw.match_id AND ci.inning = iw.inning
    WHERE ci.balls_bowled = (SELECT MIN(balls_bowled) FROM CompletedInnings)
      AND (iw.wickets_fallen = 10 OR ci.inning = 2)
)
SELECT 
    team,
    score,
    balls,
    run_rate,
    opposition
FROM ShortestInnings
ORDER BY balls ASC, score ASC
LIMIT 1;

question: For each player who carried the bat through a completed T20I innings, calculate their runs as a percentage of the team total.
gold_sql: WITH InningsTotals AS (SELECT match_id, inning, batting_team, SUM(runs_scored + extra_runs) AS team_total, COUNT(wicket_type) AS wickets_fallen FROM Deliveries GROUP BY match_id, inning), Openers AS (SELECT match_id, inning, striker_id AS player_id FROM Deliveries WHERE over_number IN (0, 1) AND ball_number = 1 UNION SELECT match_id, inning, non_striker_id AS player_id FROM Deliveries WHERE over_number IN (0, 1) AND ball_number = 1), PlayerScores AS (SELECT match_id, inning, striker_id, SUM(runs_scored) AS player_runs FROM Deliveries GROUP BY match_id, inning, striker_id), DismissedPlayers AS (SELECT match_id, inning, player_out_id FROM Deliveries WHERE player_out_id IS NOT NULL) SELECT p.player_name, ps.player_runs, it.team_total, ROUND((ps.player_runs * 100.0 / it.team_total), 2) AS percentage_of_team_total FROM PlayerScores ps JOIN InningsTotals it ON ps.match_id = it.match_id AND ps.inning = it.inning JOIN Players p ON ps.striker_id = p.player_id JOIN Openers o ON ps.match_id = o.match_id AND ps.inning = o.inning AND ps.striker_id = o.player_id LEFT JOIN DismissedPlayers dp ON ps.match_id = dp.match_id AND ps.inning = dp.inning AND ps.striker_id = dp.player_out_id WHERE dp.player_out_id IS NULL AND it.wickets_fallen = 10 ORDER BY percentage_of_team_total DESC LIMIT 5;

WITH CompletedInnings AS (
    SELECT 
        d.match_id,
        d.inning,
        d.batting_team,
        COUNT(DISTINCT d.striker_id) AS batters_out,
        MAX(d.over_number) AS max_over,
        MAX(d.ball_number) AS max_ball
    FROM Deliveries d
    WHERE d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL 
        AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('retired hurt', 'retired not out', 'retired out')
    GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.batting_team
    HAVING batters_out >= 10 OR (max_over = 19 AND max_ball >= 6)
),
CarriedBatPlayers AS (
    SELECT 
        d.match_id,
        d.inning,
        d.batting_team,
        d.striker_id AS player_id,
        SUM(d.runs_scored) AS player_runs,
        COUNT(DISTINCT d.over_number) AS overs_faced
    FROM Deliveries d
    JOIN CompletedInnings ci 
        ON d.match_id = ci.match_id 
        AND d.inning = ci.inning 
        AND d.batting_team = ci.batting_team
    WHERE d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0
    GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.batting_team, d.striker_id
    HAVING overs_faced = 20
),
TeamTotals AS (
    SELECT 
        d.match_id,
        d.inning,
        d.batting_team,
        SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) AS team_total
    FROM Deliveries d
    JOIN CompletedInnings ci 
        ON d.match_id = ci.match_id 
        AND d.inning = ci.inning 
        AND d.batting_team = ci.batting_team
    GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.batting_team
)
SELECT 
    p.player_name,
    cbp.player_runs,
    tt.team_total,
    ROUND((cbp.player_runs * 100.0 / tt.team_total), 2) AS percentage_of_team_total
FROM CarriedBatPlayers cbp
JOIN TeamTotals tt

        ts.opposition,
        m.match_date,
        m.match_winner,
        bu.distinct_bowlers_used
    FROM TeamScores ts
    INNER JOIN Matches m ON ts.match_id = m.match_id
    INNER JOIN BowlingUsage bu ON ts.match_id = bu.match_id 
        AND ts.opposition = bu.bowling_team
    WHERE m.season LIKE '%T20%'

        AND bu.distinct_bowlers_used = 5
        AND m.match_winner = ts.opposition
)

    team,
    score,
    opposition,
    match_date

ORDER BY grand_total_instances DESC, match_date;

gold_sql: WITH InningStats AS (SELECT match_id, inning, batting_team, bowling_team, SUM(runs_scored + extra_runs) AS total_score, COUNT(DISTINCT bowler_id) AS bowlers_used FROM Deliveries GROUP BY match_id, inning, batting_team, bowling_team) SELECT COUNT(*) OVER() AS grand_total_instances, i.batting_team AS team, i.total_score AS score, i.bowling_team AS opposition, m.match_date FROM InningStats i JOIN Matches m ON i.match_id = m.match_id WHERE i.total_score >= 220 AND i.bowlers_used = 5 AND m.match_winner IS NOT NULL AND i.batting_team != m.match_winner ORDER BY i.total_score DESC;
generated_sql:
WITH BowlingTeamBowlerCounts AS (
    SELECT 
        d.match_id,
        d.bowling_team,
        COUNT(DISTINCT d.bowler_id) AS distinct_bowlers_used
    FROM Deliveries d
    WHERE d.inning = 1
    GROUP BY d.match_id, d.bowling_team
),
TeamScores AS (
    SELECT 
        d.match_id,
        d.batting_team AS team,
        SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) AS total_runs,
        m.match_date,
        m.match_winner,
        m.team1,
        m.team2
    FROM Deliveries d
    JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
    WHERE d.inning = 1
    GROUP BY d.match_id, d.batting_team
),
FilteredMatches AS (
    SELECT 
        ts.match_id,
        ts.team,
        ts.total_runs AS score,
        ts.match_date,
        ts.match_winner,
        btc.distinct_bowlers_used,
        CASE 
            WHEN ts.team = m.team1 THEN m.team2 
            ELSE m.team1 
        END AS opposition
    FROM TeamScores ts
    JOIN Matches m ON ts.match_id = m.match_id
    JOIN BowlingTeamBowlerCounts btc ON ts.match_id = btc.match_id AND btc.bowling_team = ts.team
    WHERE ts.total_runs >= 220 
      AND btc.distinct_bowlers_used = 5 
      AND ts.match_winner != ts.team
)
SELECT 
    COUNT(*) AS grand_total_instances,
    team,
    score,
    opposition,
    match_date
FROM FilteredMatches
GROUP BY match_id, team, score, opposition, match_date
ORDER BY grand_total_instances DESC, match_date DESC;

question: किसी एक मैदान पर बिना हार के किसी प्रतिद्वंद्वी के खिलाफ किसी टीम की सबसे अधिक T20I जीत कितनी है?
gold_sql: WITH all_matches AS ( SELECT match_id, venue, team1 AS team, team2 AS opponent, match_winner FROM Matches WHERE team1 IN ('Afghanistan','Australia','Bangladesh','England','India','Ireland','New Zealand','Pakistan','South Africa','Sri Lanka','West Indies','Zimbabwe') AND team2 IN ('Afghanistan','Australia','Bangladesh','England','India','Ireland','New Zealand','Pakistan','South Africa','Sri Lanka','West Indies','Zimbabwe') UNION ALL SELECT match_id, venue, team2, team1, match_winner FROM Matches WHERE team1 IN ('Afghanistan','Australia','Bangladesh','England','India','Ireland','New Zealand','Pakistan','South Africa','Sri Lanka','West Indies','Zimbabwe') AND team2 IN ('Afghanistan','Australia','Bangladesh','England','India','Ireland','New Zealand','Pakistan','South Africa','Sri Lanka','West Indies','Zimbabwe') ), venue_records AS ( SELECT team, opponent, venue, COUNT(CASE WHEN match_winner = team THEN 1 END) AS wins, COUNT(CASE WHEN match_winner = opponent THEN 1 END) AS losses FROM all_matches GROUP BY team, opponent, venue ) SELECT team, opponent, venue, wins FROM venue_records WHERE losses = 0 AND wins >= 5 ORDER BY wins DESC;
generated_sql:
WITH TeamWins AS (
    SELECT 
        m.match_winner AS team,
        CASE 
            WHEN m.team1 = m.match_winner THEN m.team2 
            ELSE m.team1 
        END AS opponent,
        m.venue,
        COUNT(*) AS wins
    FROM Matches m
    WHERE m.match_winner IS NOT NULL
        AND m.season LIKE '%T20I%'
    GROUP BY m.match_winner, 
             CASE 
                 WHEN m.team1 = m.match_winner THEN m.team2 
                 ELSE m.team1 
             END, 
             m.venue
),
RankedWins AS (
    SELECT 
        team,
        opponent,
        venue,
        wins,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY venue ORDER BY wins DESC) AS rn
    FROM TeamWins
)
SELECT 
    team,
    opponent,
    venue,
    wins
FROM RankedWins
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY wins DESC
LIMIT 1;

question: What are the most T20I wins by a team against an opposition at a single venue without suffering a defeat?
gold_sql: WITH all_matches AS ( SELECT match_id, venue, team1 AS team, team2 AS opponent, match_winner FROM Matches WHERE team1 IN ('Afghanistan','Australia','Bangladesh','England','India','Ireland','New Zealand','Pakistan','South Africa','Sri Lanka','West Indies','Zimbabwe') AND team2 IN ('Afghanistan','Australia','Bangladesh','England','India','Ireland','New Zealand','Pakistan','South Africa','Sri Lanka','West Indies','Zimbabwe') UNION ALL SELECT match_id, venue, team2, team1, match_winner FROM Matches WHERE team1 IN ('Afghanistan','Australia','Bangladesh','England','India','Ireland','New Zealand','Pakistan','South Africa','Sri Lanka','West Indies','Zimbabwe') AND team2 IN ('Afghanistan','Australia','Bangladesh','England','India','Ireland','New Zealand','Pakistan','South Africa','Sri Lanka','West Indies','Zimbabwe') ), venue_records AS ( SELECT team, opponent, venue, COUNT(CASE WHEN match_winner = team THEN 1 END) AS wins, COUNT(CASE WHEN match_winner = opponent THEN 1 END) AS losses FROM all_matches GROUP BY team, opponent, venue ) SELECT team, opponent, venue, wins FROM venue_records WHERE losses = 0 AND wins >= 5 ORDER BY wins DESC;
generated_sql:
WITH MatchResults AS (
    SELECT 
        match_id,
        venue,
        team1,
        team2,
        match_winner,
        result_type
    FROM Matches
    WHERE result_type = 'runs' OR result_type = 'wickets'
),
TeamWins AS (
    SELECT 
        CASE 
            WHEN team1 = match_winner THEN team1
            WHEN team2 = match_winner THEN team2
        END AS team,
        CASE 
            WHEN team1 = match_winner THEN team2
            WHEN team2 = match_winner THEN team1
        END AS opponent,
        venue,
        COUNT(*) AS wins
    FROM MatchResults
    WHERE match_winner IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY team, opponent, venue
),
TeamLosses AS (
    SELECT 
        CASE 
            WHEN team1 = match_winner THEN team2
            WHEN team2 = match_winner THEN team1
        END AS team,
        CASE 
            WHEN team1 = match_winner THEN team1
            WHEN team2 = match_winner THEN team2
        END AS opponent,
        venue,
        COUNT(*) AS losses
    FROM MatchResults
    WHERE match_winner IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY team, opponent, venue
),
UndefeatedRecords AS (
    SELECT 
        w.team,
        w.opponent,
        w.venue,
        w.wins,
        COALESCE(l.losses, 0) AS losses
    FROM TeamWins w
    LEFT JOIN TeamLosses l ON w.team = l.team 
        AND w.opponent = l.opponent 
        AND w.venue = l.venue
    WHERE COALESCE(l.losses, 0) = 0
)
SELECT 
    team,
    opponent,
    venue,
    wins
FROM UndefeatedRecords
ORDER BY wins DESC;

question: ਕਿਸੇ ਇੱਕ ਮੈਦਾਨ 'ਤੇ ਬਿਨਾਂ ਹਾਰ ਦੇ ਕਿਸੇ ਵਿਰੋਧੀ ਦੇ ਖਿਲਾਫ਼ ਕਿਸੇ ਟੀਮ ਦੀਆਂ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ T20I ਜਿੱਤਾਂ ਕਿੰਨੀਆਂ ਹਨ?
gold_sql: WITH all_matches AS ( SELECT match_id, venue, team1 AS team, team2 AS opponent, match_winner FROM Matches WHERE team1 IN ('Afghanistan','Australia','Bangladesh','England','India','Ireland','New Zealand','Pakistan','South Africa','Sri Lanka','West Indies','Zimbabwe') AND team2 IN ('Afghanistan','Australia','Bangladesh','England','India','Ireland','New Zealand','Pakistan','South Africa','Sri Lanka','West Indies','Zimbabwe') UNION ALL SELECT match_id, venue, team2, team1, match_winner FROM Matches WHERE team1 IN ('Afghanistan','Australia','Bangladesh','England','India','Ireland','New Zealand','Pakistan','South Africa','Sri Lanka','West Indies','Zimbabwe') AND team2 IN ('Afghanistan','Australia','Bangladesh','England','India','Ireland','New Zealand','Pakistan','South Africa','Sri Lanka','West Indies','Zimbabwe') ), venue_records AS ( SELECT team, opponent, venue, COUNT(CASE WHEN match_winner = team THEN 1 END) AS wins, COUNT(CASE WHEN match_winner = opponent THEN 1 END) AS losses FROM all_matches GROUP BY team, opponent, venue ) SELECT team, opponent, venue, wins FROM venue_records WHERE losses = 0 AND wins >= 5 ORDER BY wins DESC;
generated_sql:
WITH TeamWins AS (
    SELECT 
        m.match_winner AS team,
        CASE 
            WHEN m.team1 = m.match_winner THEN m.team2 
            ELSE m.team1 
        END AS opponent,
        m.venue,
        COUNT(*) AS wins
    FROM Matches m
    WHERE m.match_winner IS NOT NULL
        AND m.season LIKE '%T20I%'
    GROUP BY m.match_winner, 
             CASE 
                 WHEN m.team1 = m.match_winner THEN m.team2 
                 ELSE m.team1 
             END, 
             m.venue
),
TeamLosses AS (
    SELECT 
        m.team1 AS team,
        m.team2 AS opponent,
        m.venue
    FROM Matches m
    WHERE m.match_winner IS NOT NULL
        AND m.match_winner = m.team2
        AND m.season LIKE '%T20I%'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        m.team2 AS team,
        m.team1 AS opponent,
        m.venue
    FROM Matches m
    WHERE m.match_winner IS NOT NULL
        AND m.match_winner = m.team1
        AND m.season LIKE '%T20I%'
),
UndefeatedRecords AS (
    SELECT 
        tw.team,
        tw.opponent,
        tw.venue,
        tw.wins
    FROM TeamWins tw
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM TeamLosses tl
        WHERE tl.team = tw.team
            AND tl.opponent = tw.opponent
            AND tl.venue = tw.venue
    )
)
SELECT 
    team,
    opponent,
    venue,
    wins
FROM UndefeatedRecords
ORDER BY wins DESC
LIMIT 1;

question: టీ20ఐలలో, ప్రత్యర్థి జట్టు కేవలం ఐదుగురు బౌలర్లను మాత్రమే ఉపయోగించినప్పుడు, ఒక జట్టు 220+ పరుగులు చేసినప్పటికీ ఎన్నిసార్లు మ్యాచ్‌లో ఓడిపోయింది? ఆ జట్ల పేర్లు, స్కోర్లు మరియు ప్రత్యర్థి జట్లను తెలపండి
gold_sql: WITH BatterInnings AS (SELECT d.striker_id AS player_id, d.match_id, d.inning, d.batting_team, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS innings_runs FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE m.match_winner IS NOT NULL AND d.batting_team != m.match_winner GROUP BY d.striker_id, d.match_id, d.inning, d.batting_team) SELECT p.player_name, bi.innings_runs AS score, bi.batting_team AS team, CASE WHEN m.team1 = bi.batting_team THEN m.team2 ELSE m.team1 END AS opposition, m.match_date FROM BatterInnings bi JOIN Players p ON bi.player_id = p.player_id JOIN Matches m ON bi.match_id = m.match_id WHERE p.player_name LIKE '%Watson%' ORDER BY bi.innings_runs DESC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
WITH BowlerCounts AS (
    SELECT 
        d.match_id,
        d.bowling_team,
        COUNT(DISTINCT d.bowler_id) AS distinct_bowlers_used
    FROM Deliveries d
    WHERE d.inning = 1
    GROUP BY d.match_id, d.bowling_team
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT d.bowler_id) = 5
),
TeamScores AS (
    SELECT 
        d.match_id,
        d.batting_team AS team,
        SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) AS total_runs
    FROM Deliveries d
    WHERE d.inning = 1
    GROUP BY d.match_id, d.batting_team
    HAVING SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) >= 220
),
QualifiedMatches AS (
    SELECT 
        bc.match_id,
        bc.bowling_team AS opposition,
        ts.team,
        ts.total_runs AS score
    FROM BowlerCounts bc
    INNER JOIN TeamScores ts ON bc.match_id = ts.match_id AND bc.bowling_team = ts.team
    INNER JOIN Matches m ON bc.match_id = m.match_id
    WHERE m.match_winner = bc.bowling_team
)
SELECT 
    p.player_name,
    qm.score,
    qm.team,
    qm.opposition,
    m.match_date
FROM QualifiedMatches qm
INNER JOIN Matches m ON qm.match_id = m.match_id
INNER JOIN PlayerInMatch pim ON m.match_id = pim.match_id AND pim.team_name = qm.team
INNER JOIN Players p ON pim.player_id = p.player_id
WHERE p.player_id = (
    SELECT player_of_match_id 
    FROM Matches m2 
    WHERE m2.match_id = qm.match_id
)
ORDER BY qm.score DESC, m.match_date;

question: What are the highest individual scores for India in T20 World Cups?
gold_sql: SELECT p.player_name, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS runs, CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id = d.striker_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0 THEN '*' ELSE '' END AS not_out, m.venue, m.season, CASE WHEN m.team1 = 'India' THEN m.team2 ELSE m.team1 END AS opponent FROM Deliveries d JOIN Players p ON d.striker_id = p.player_id JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE d.batting_team = 'India' GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.striker_id, p.player_name, m.venue, m.season, opponent ORDER BY runs DESC LIMIT 10;
gold_answer: ('SA Yadav', 112, '*', 'Saurashtra Cricket Association Stadium, Rajkot', '2022/23', 'Sri Lanka')
('RG Sharma', 111, '*', 'Bharat Ratna Shri Atal Bihari Vajpayee Ekana Cricket Stadium', '2018/19', 'West Indies')
generated_sql:
WITH IndiaMatches AS (
    SELECT match_id, team1, team2, season, venue
    FROM Matches
    WHERE stage LIKE '%World Cup%' AND (team1 = 'India' OR team2 = 'India')
),
IndiaBatters AS (
    SELECT 
        d.match_id,
        d.striker_id,
        p.player_name,
        SUM(d.runs_scored) AS runs,
        MAX(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_out
    FROM Deliveries d
    JOIN IndiaMatches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
    JOIN Players p ON d.striker_id = p.player_id
    WHERE d.batting_team = 'India'
    GROUP BY d.match_id, d.striker_id
),
OpponentInfo AS (
    SELECT 
        match_id,
        CASE 
            WHEN team1 = 'India' THEN team2
            ELSE team1
        END AS opponent
    FROM IndiaMatches
)
SELECT 
    ib.player_name,
    ib.runs,
    CASE WHEN ib.is_out = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS not_out,
    m.venue,
    m.season,
    oi.opponent
FROM IndiaBatters ib
JOIN IndiaMatches m ON ib.match_id = m.match_id
JOIN OpponentInfo oi ON ib.match_id = oi.match_id
ORDER BY ib.runs DESC, ib.is_out ASC
LIMIT 1;

      AND season LIKE '%T20 World Cup%'

question: What is the T20 head-to-head record of Sanju Samson against Jason Holder?
gold_sql: SELECT p_bat.player_name AS batter, p_bowl.player_name AS bowler, COUNT(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 THEN 1 END) AS balls, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS runs, COUNT(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id = d.striker_id AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out','retired hurt','retired out') THEN 1 END) AS dismissals, ROUND(SUM(d.runs_scored) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id = d.striker_id AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out','retired hurt','retired out') THEN 1 END),0),2) AS average, ROUND(SUM(d.runs_scored)*100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN d.wides=0 THEN 1 END),0),2) AS strike_rate FROM Deliveries d JOIN Players p_bat ON d.striker_id = p_bat.player_id JOIN Players p_bowl ON d.bowler_id = p_bowl.player_id WHERE p_bat.player_name LIKE '%Samson%' AND p_bowl.player_name LIKE '%Holder%' GROUP BY p_bat.player_name, p_bowl.player_name;

    SELECT 
        d.striker_id AS batter_id,
        d.bowler_id AS bowler_id,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 END) AS balls,
        SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) AS total_runs,
        SUM(CASE 
            WHEN d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL 
            AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field')
            THEN 1 
            ELSE 0 
        END) AS dismissals
    FROM Deliveries d
    INNER JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
    WHERE d.striker_id = (SELECT player_id FROM Players WHERE player_name = 'Sanju Samson')
    AND d.bowler_id = (SELECT player_id FROM Players WHERE player_name = 'Jason Holder')
    AND m.season LIKE '%T20%'
    GROUP BY d.striker_id, d.bowler_id
)
SELECT 
    'Sanju Samson' AS batter,
    'Jason Holder' AS bowler,
    COALESCE(balls, 0) AS balls,
    COALESCE(total_runs, 0) AS runs,
    COALESCE(dismissals, 0) AS dismissals,
    CASE 
        WHEN COALESCE(dismissals, 0) = 0 THEN NULL 
        ELSE ROUND(CAST(COALESCE(total_runs, 0) AS REAL) / dismissals, 2) 
    END AS average,
    CASE 
        WHEN COALESCE(balls, 0) = 0 THEN NULL 
        ELSE ROUND(CAST(COALESCE(total_runs, 0) AS REAL) * 100 / balls, 2) 
    END AS strike_rate
FROM SamsonVsHolder;

question: Which captain has the most wins in Men’s T20 World Cup history?
gold_sql: SELECT p.player_name, COUNT(m.match_id) AS total_wins FROM Matches m JOIN PlayerInMatch pim ON m.match_id = pim.match_id AND m.match_winner = pim.team_name JOIN Players p ON pim.player_id = p.player_id GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name ORDER BY total_wins DESC LIMIT 1;

    SELECT 
        m.match_id,
        m.match_winner,
        pim.player_id AS captain_id,
        p.player_name
    FROM Matches m
    JOIN PlayerInMatch pim ON m.match_id = pim.match_id
    JOIN Players p ON pim.player_id = p.player_id
    WHERE m.season LIKE '%T20 World Cup%' 
      AND m.match_winner IS NOT NULL
      AND pim.team_name = m.match_winner
    GROUP BY m.match_id, m.match_winner
    HAVING pim.player_id = MIN(pim.player_id)
)
SELECT 
    player_name,
    COUNT(*) AS total_wins
FROM MatchCaptains
GROUP BY captain_id, player_name
ORDER BY total_wins DESC
LIMIT 1;

question: T20Is లో South Africa తరఫున అత్యధిక వికెట్లు తీసిన ఆటగాడు ఎవరు?
gold_sql: SELECT p.player_name, COUNT(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id IS NOT NULL AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out','retired hurt','retired out', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 END) AS wickets FROM Deliveries d JOIN Players p ON d.bowler_id = p.player_id WHERE d.bowling_team = 'South Africa' GROUP BY d.bowler_id, p.player_name ORDER BY wickets DESC LIMIT 10;
generated_sql:
WITH SouthAfricaMatches AS (
    SELECT match_id
    FROM Matches
    WHERE season LIKE '%T20I%'
      AND (team1 = 'South Africa' OR team2 = 'South Africa')
),
SouthAfricaBowlers AS (
    SELECT d.bowler_id, COUNT(*) AS wickets
    FROM Deliveries d
    INNER JOIN SouthAfricaMatches sm ON d.match_id = sm.match_id
    INNER JOIN PlayerInMatch pim ON d.match_id = pim.match_id AND d.bowler_id = pim.player_id
    WHERE pim.team_name = 'South Africa'
      AND d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL
      AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field')
    GROUP BY d.bowler_id
)
SELECT p.player_name, sb.wickets
FROM SouthAfricaBowlers sb
INNER JOIN Players p ON sb.bowler_id = p.player_id
ORDER BY sb.wickets DESC
LIMIT 1;

question: Which captain has hit the most sixes in T20 World Cups?
gold_sql: SELECT p.player_name, COUNT(*) AS total_sixes FROM Deliveries d JOIN Players p ON d.striker_id = p.player_id WHERE d.runs_scored = 6 GROUP BY d.striker_id, p.player_name ORDER BY total_sixes DESC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
WITH CaptainMatches AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.match_id, pim.player_id
    FROM Matches m
    JOIN PlayerInMatch pim ON m.match_id = pim.match_id
    WHERE m.season LIKE '%T20 World Cup%'
      AND (m.team1 = pim.team_name OR m.team2 = pim.team_name)
      AND pim.player_id IN (
          SELECT player_id 
          FROM Players 
          WHERE player_name LIKE '%(c)%' OR player_name LIKE '%(c & wk)%'
      )
),
SixDeliveries AS (
    SELECT d.striker_id, COUNT(*) AS six_count
    FROM Deliveries d
    JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
    WHERE m.season LIKE '%T20 World Cup%'
      AND d.runs_scored = 6
      AND d.wides = 0
      AND d.noballs = 0
    GROUP BY d.striker_id
)
SELECT p.player_name, COALESCE(sd.six_count, 0) AS total_sixes
FROM CaptainMatches cm
JOIN Players p ON cm.player_id = p.player_id
LEFT JOIN SixDeliveries sd ON cm.player_id = sd.striker_id
WHERE sd.six_count IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY total_sixes DESC
LIMIT 1;

question: T20 World Cups में सबसे अधिक छक्के किस कप्तान ने लगाए हैं?
gold_sql: SELECT p.player_name, COUNT(*) AS total_sixes FROM Deliveries d JOIN Players p ON d.striker_id = p.player_id WHERE d.runs_scored = 6 GROUP BY d.striker_id, p.player_name ORDER BY total_sixes DESC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
WITH CaptainMatches AS (
    SELECT 
        m.match_id,
        m.match_winner,
        pim.player_id,
        pim.team_name
    FROM Matches m
    JOIN PlayerInMatch pim ON m.match_id = pim.match_id
    WHERE m.season LIKE '%T20 World Cup%'
      AND pim.player_id IN (
          SELECT player_id 
          FROM PlayerInMatch pim2 
          WHERE pim2.match_id = m.match_id 
            AND pim2.team_name = m.match_winner
      )
      AND pim.team_name = m.match_winner
    GROUP BY m.match_id, pim.player_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) = 11  -- Assuming captain is in the playing XI of the winning team
),
SixesByCaptain AS (
    SELECT 
        cm.player_id,
        COUNT(*) AS total_sixes
    FROM Deliveries d
    JOIN CaptainMatches cm ON d.match_id = cm.match_id 
        AND d.striker_id = cm.player_id
    WHERE d.runs_scored = 6
      AND d.inning IN (1, 2)  -- Both innings
    GROUP BY cm.player_id
)
SELECT 
    p.player_name,
    COALESCE(sbc.total_sixes, 0) AS total_sixes
FROM Players p
LEFT JOIN SixesByCaptain sbc ON p.player_id = sbc.player_id
WHERE sbc.total_sixes IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY total_sixes DESC
LIMIT 1;

question: T20 World Cups ਵਿੱਚ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਛੱਕੇ ਕਿਹੜੇ ਕਪਤਾਨ ਨੇ ਲਗਾਏ ਹਨ?
gold_sql: SELECT p.player_name, COUNT(*) AS total_sixes FROM Deliveries d JOIN Players p ON d.striker_id = p.player_id WHERE d.runs_scored = 6 GROUP BY d.striker_id, p.player_name ORDER BY total_sixes DESC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
WITH T20WorldCupMatches AS (
    SELECT match_id, season
    FROM Matches
    WHERE season LIKE '%T20 World Cup%'
),
SixesByCaptain AS (
    SELECT 
        p.player_name,
        COUNT(*) AS total_sixes
    FROM Deliveries d
    INNER JOIN T20WorldCupMatches tm ON d.match_id = tm.match_id
    INNER JOIN PlayerInMatch pim ON d.match_id = pim.match_id AND d.striker_id = pim.player_id
    INNER JOIN Players p ON pim.player_id = p.player_id
    WHERE d.runs_scored = 6
      AND pim.team_name IN (d.batting_team, d.bowling_team)
      AND pim.player_id IN (
          SELECT player_id 
          FROM PlayerInMatch pim2 
          WHERE pim2.match_id = d.match_id 
            AND pim2.team_name = d.batting_team
            AND pim2.player_id = d.striker_id
      )
    GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name
)
SELECT player_name, total_sixes
FROM SixesByCaptain
ORDER BY total_sixes DESC
LIMIT 1;

    WHERE season LIKE '%T20 World Cup%'
),

    FROM Deliveries d
    INNER JOIN T20WorldCupMatches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
    WHERE d.runs_scored = 6

question: Which player has taken the most wickets for South Africa in T20Is?
gold_sql: SELECT p.player_name, COUNT(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id IS NOT NULL AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out','retired hurt','retired out', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 END) AS wickets FROM Deliveries d JOIN Players p ON d.bowler_id = p.player_id WHERE d.bowling_team = 'South Africa' GROUP BY d.bowler_id, p.player_name ORDER BY wickets DESC LIMIT 10;
generated_sql:
WITH SouthAfricaMatches AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT match_id
    FROM PlayerInMatch
    WHERE team_name = 'South Africa'
),
WicketDeliveries AS (
    SELECT 
        d.delivery_id,
        d.match_id,
        d.bowler_id,
        d.wicket_type
    FROM Deliveries d
    INNER JOIN SouthAfricaMatches sam ON d.match_id = sam.match_id
    WHERE d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL 
        AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field')
),
SouthAfricaBowlers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT pim.player_id
    FROM PlayerInMatch pim
    WHERE pim.team_name = 'South Africa'
)
SELECT 
    p.player_name AS player_name,
    COUNT(wd.delivery_id) AS wickets
FROM WicketDeliveries wd
INNER JOIN SouthAfricaBowlers sab ON wd.bowler_id = sab.player_id
INNER JOIN Players p ON wd.bowler_id = p.player_id
GROUP BY wd.bowler_id, p.player_name
ORDER BY wickets DESC, player_name
LIMIT 1;

question: What are the highest individual scores in T20 World Cups by players batting at number 7 or below?
gold_sql: WITH batting_order AS ( SELECT d.match_id, d.inning, d.striker_id, MIN(d.delivery_id) AS first_ball_faced FROM Deliveries d GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.striker_id ), ranked_batters AS ( SELECT match_id, inning, striker_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY match_id, inning ORDER BY first_ball_faced ) AS bat_pos FROM batting_order ), innings_scores AS ( SELECT d.match_id, d.inning, d.striker_id, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS runs, CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id = d.striker_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0 THEN '*' ELSE '' END AS not_out FROM Deliveries d GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.striker_id ) SELECT p.player_name, s.runs, s.not_out, rb.bat_pos, m.venue, m.season, d_team.batting_team FROM innings_scores s JOIN ranked_batters rb ON s.match_id = rb.match_id AND s.inning = rb.inning AND s.striker_id = rb.striker_id JOIN Players p ON s.striker_id = p.player_id JOIN Matches m ON s.match_id = m.match_id JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT match_id, inning, batting_team FROM Deliveries) d_team ON s.match_id = d_team.match_id AND s.inning = d_team.inning WHERE rb.bat_pos >= 7 ORDER BY s.runs DESC LIMIT 10;

gold_sql: SELECT d.batting_team, CASE WHEN m.team1 = 'Pakistan' THEN m.team2 ELSE m.team1 END AS opponent, SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) AS total_runs, COUNT(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS wickets_lost, m.venue, m.season FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE d.batting_team = 'Pakistan' GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.batting_team, opponent, m.venue, m.season ORDER BY total_runs DESC LIMIT 10;
generated_sql:
WITH PakistanMatches AS (
    SELECT 
        m.match_id,
        m.season,
        m.venue,
        CASE 
            WHEN m.team1 = 'Pakistan' THEN m.team2
            ELSE m.team1 
        END AS opponent
    FROM Matches m
    WHERE m.team1 = 'Pakistan' OR m.team2 = 'Pakistan'
),
TeamTotals AS (
    SELECT 
        d.match_id,
        d.batting_team,
        SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) AS total_runs,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS wickets_lost
    FROM Deliveries d
    WHERE d.batting_team = 'Pakistan'
    GROUP BY d.match_id, d.batting_team
)
SELECT 
    'Pakistan' AS batting_team,
    pm.opponent,
    tt.total_runs,
    tt.wickets_lost,
    pm.venue,
    pm.season
FROM TeamTotals tt
JOIN PakistanMatches pm ON tt.match_id = pm.match_id
ORDER BY tt.total_runs DESC, tt.wickets_lost ASC;

question: T20Is ਵਿੱਚ Pakistan ਦੇ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਟੀਮ ਟੋਟਲ ਕਿਹੜੇ ਹਨ?
gold_sql: SELECT d.batting_team, CASE WHEN m.team1 = 'Pakistan' THEN m.team2 ELSE m.team1 END AS opponent, SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) AS total_runs, COUNT(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS wickets_lost, m.venue, m.season FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE d.batting_team = 'Pakistan' GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.batting_team, opponent, m.venue, m.season ORDER BY total_runs DESC LIMIT 10;
generated_sql:
WITH PakistanMatches AS (
    SELECT 
        m.match_id,
        m.season,
        m.venue,
        CASE 
            WHEN m.team1 = 'Pakistan' THEN m.team2
            ELSE m.team1 
        END AS opponent
    FROM Matches m
    WHERE m.team1 = 'Pakistan' OR m.team2 = 'Pakistan'
),
InningsTotals AS (
    SELECT 
        d.match_id,
        d.batting_team,
        SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) AS total_runs,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 END) AS wickets_lost
    FROM Deliveries d
    WHERE d.batting_team = 'Pakistan'
    GROUP BY d.match_id, d.batting_team
)
SELECT 
    'Pakistan' AS batting_team,
    pm.opponent,
    it.total_runs,
    it.wickets_lost,
    pm.venue,
    pm.season
FROM PakistanMatches pm
JOIN InningsTotals it ON pm.match_id = it.match_id
ORDER BY it.total_runs DESC, it.wickets_lost ASC;

question: T20Is లో Pakistan అత్యధిక జట్టు స్కోర్లు ఏవి?
gold_sql: SELECT d.batting_team, CASE WHEN m.team1 = 'Pakistan' THEN m.team2 ELSE m.team1 END AS opponent, SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) AS total_runs, COUNT(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS wickets_lost, m.venue, m.season FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE d.batting_team = 'Pakistan' GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.batting_team, opponent, m.venue, m.season ORDER BY total_runs DESC LIMIT 10;
generated_sql:
WITH PakistanMatches AS (
    SELECT 
        m.match_id,
        m.season,
        m.venue,
        CASE 
            WHEN m.team1 = 'Pakistan' THEN m.team2
            ELSE m.team1
        END AS opponent
    FROM Matches m
    WHERE m.team1 = 'Pakistan' OR m.team2 = 'Pakistan'
),
InningsTotals AS (
    SELECT 
        d.match_id,
        d.batting_team,
        SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) AS total_runs,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 END) AS wickets_lost
    FROM Deliveries d
    WHERE d.batting_team = 'Pakistan'
    GROUP BY d.match_id, d.batting_team
)
SELECT 
    it.batting_team,
    pm.opponent,
    it.total_runs,
    it.wickets_lost,
    pm.venue,
    pm.season
FROM InningsTotals it
JOIN PakistanMatches pm ON it.match_id = pm.match_id
ORDER BY it.total_runs DESC, it.wickets_lost ASC
LIMIT 10;

question: What are the highest individual scores for Pakistan in T20 World Cups?
gold_sql: SELECT p.player_name, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS runs, CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id = d.striker_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0 THEN '*' ELSE '' END AS not_out, m.venue, m.season, CASE WHEN m.team1 = 'Pakistan' THEN m.team2 ELSE m.team1 END AS opponent FROM Deliveries d JOIN Players p ON d.striker_id = p.player_id JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE d.batting_team = 'Pakistan' GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.striker_id, p.player_name, m.venue, m.season, opponent ORDER BY runs DESC LIMIT 10;
generated_sql:
WITH PakistanMatches AS (
    SELECT 
        m.match_id,
        m.season,
        m.venue,
        CASE 
            WHEN m.team1 = 'Pakistan' THEN m.team2
            ELSE m.team1 
        END AS opponent
    FROM Matches m
    WHERE (m.team1 = 'Pakistan' OR m.team2 = 'Pakistan')
      AND m.season LIKE '%T20 World Cup%'
),
PlayerRuns AS (
    SELECT 
        d.match_id,
        p.player_name,
        d.striker_id,
        SUM(d.runs_scored) AS runs,
        MAX(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL AND d.player_out_id = d.striker_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_out
    FROM Deliveries d
    JOIN Players p ON d.striker_id = p.player_id
    JOIN PakistanMatches pm ON d.match_id = pm.match_id
    WHERE d.batting_team = 'Pakistan'
    GROUP BY d.match_id, d.striker_id, p.player_name
),
RankedScores AS (
    SELECT 
        pr.player_name,
        pr.runs,
        CASE WHEN pr.is_out = 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS not_out,
        pm.venue,
        pm.season,
        pm.opponent,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY pr.player_name ORDER BY pr.runs DESC) AS rn
    FROM PlayerRuns pr
    JOIN PakistanMatches pm ON pr.match_id = pm.match_id
)
SELECT 
    player_name,
    runs,
    not_out,
    venue,
    season,
    opponent
FROM RankedScores
WHERE rn = 1

question: Which Pakistan bowlers took the fewest matches to reach 50 T20I wickets?

        d.bowler_id,
        m.match_id,

question: What are the highest targets successfully chased in 18–20 overs in T20 World Cups?
gold_sql: WITH chasing_innings AS ( SELECT d.match_id, d.batting_team, SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) AS runs_chased, MAX(d.over_number) AS last_over FROM Deliveries d WHERE d.inning = 2 GROUP BY d.match_id, d.batting_team ), last_wicket_over AS ( SELECT match_id, MAX(over_number) AS over_completed FROM Deliveries WHERE inning = 2 AND player_out_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY match_id ) SELECT ci.batting_team AS chasing_team, ci.runs_chased, lwo.over_completed AS overs_used, m.venue, m.season FROM chasing_innings ci JOIN Matches m ON ci.match_id = m.match_id JOIN last_wicket_over lwo ON ci.match_id = lwo.match_id WHERE m.match_winner = ci.batting_team AND lwo.over_completed >= 17 ORDER BY ci.runs_chased DESC LIMIT 10;
generated_sql:
WITH MatchTargets AS (
    SELECT 
        m.match_id,
        m.season,
        m.venue,
        m.team1,
        m.team2,
        m.match_winner AS chasing_team,
        CASE 
            WHEN m.match_winner = m.team1 THEN m.team2
            ELSE m.team1
        END AS defending_team,
        SUM(CASE 
            WHEN d.batting_team = m.team1 AND d.inning = 1 THEN d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs
            WHEN d.batting_team = m.team2 AND d.inning = 1 THEN d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs
            ELSE 0
        END) AS first_innings_runs
    FROM Matches m
    JOIN Deliveries d ON m.match_id = d.match_id
    WHERE m.season LIKE '%T20 World Cup%'
        AND m.result_type = 'runs'
        AND m.match_winner IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY m.match_id, m.season, m.venue, m.team1, m.team2, m.match_winner
),
ChaseDetails AS (
    SELECT 
        mt.match_id,
        mt.season,
        mt.venue,
        mt.chasing_team,
        mt.first_innings_runs + 1 AS runs_chased,
        MAX(d.over_number) + (MAX(d.ball_number) * 1.0 / 100) AS overs_used_decimal
    FROM MatchTargets mt
    JOIN Deliveries d ON mt.match_id = d.match_id
    WHERE d.batting_team = mt.chasing_team
        AND d.inning = 2
        AND (d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) >= mt.first_innings_runs + 1
    GROUP BY mt.match_id, mt.season, mt.venue, mt.chasing_team, mt.first_innings_runs
)

    chasing_team,
    runs_chased,
    ROUND(overs_used_decimal, 2) AS overs_used,
    venue,
    season
FROM ChaseDetails
WHERE overs_used_decimal BETWEEN 17.5 AND 20.0
ORDER BY runs_chased DESC;

question: What is the T20I head-to-head record of Rachin Ravindra against Sam Curran?
gold_sql: SELECT p_bat.player_name AS batter, p_bowl.player_name AS bowler, COUNT(DISTINCT d.match_id) AS innings, COUNT(CASE WHEN d.wides=0 THEN 1 END) AS balls, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS runs, COUNT(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id=d.striker_id AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out','retired hurt','retired out') THEN 1 END) AS dismissals FROM Deliveries d JOIN Players p_bat ON d.striker_id = p_bat.player_id JOIN Players p_bowl ON d.bowler_id = p_bowl.player_id WHERE p_bat.player_name LIKE '%Ravindra%' AND p_bowl.player_name LIKE '%Curran%' GROUP BY p_bat.player_name, p_bowl.player_name;

    SELECT player_id, player_name FROM Players
),
HeadToHead AS (
    SELECT 
        p1.player_name AS batter_name,
        p2.player_name AS bowler_name,
        d.inning,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 END) AS balls_faced,
        SUM(d.runs_scored) AS runs_scored,
        SUM(CASE 
            WHEN d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL 
            AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field')
            THEN 1 
            ELSE 0 
        END) AS dismissals
    FROM Deliveries d
    JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
    JOIN PlayerNames p1 ON d.striker_id = p1.player_id
    JOIN PlayerNames p2 ON d.bowler_id = p2.player_id
    WHERE p1.player_name = 'Rachin Ravindra'
      AND p2.player_name = 'Sam Curran'
      AND m.stage = 'T20I'
    GROUP BY p1.player_name, p2.player_name, d.inning
)

    bowler_name AS bowler,
    inning AS innings,
    balls_faced AS balls,
    runs_scored AS runs,
    dismissals
FROM HeadToHead

        d.striker_id,
        SUM(d.runs_scored) AS runs,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 END) AS balls_faced
    FROM Deliveries d
    JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
    WHERE m.season = '2026' 
      AND d.inning IN (1, 2)
    GROUP BY d.match_id, d.batting_team, d.striker_id
    HAVING runs >= 20 AND balls_faced > 0
),
QualifiedBatters AS (
    SELECT 
        it.match_id,
        it.batting_team,
        it.striker_id,
        p.player_name,
        it.runs,
        ROUND((CAST(it.runs AS REAL) / it.balls_faced) * 100, 2) AS strike_rate
    FROM InningTotals it
    JOIN Players p ON it.striker_id = p.player_id
    WHERE ((CAST(it.runs AS REAL) / it.balls_faced) * 100) >= 150
),
TeamQualifierCount AS (
    SELECT 
        qb.match_id,
        qb.batting_team,
        COUNT(DISTINCT qb.striker_id) AS qualifiers
    FROM QualifiedBatters qb
    GROUP BY qb.match_id, qb.batting_team
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT qb.striker_id) >= 3
),
FirstIndianBatting AS (
    SELECT 
        tqc.match_id,
        tqc.batting_team,
        tqc.qualifiers,
        m.venue,
        m.match_date,
        m.season,
        CASE 
            WHEN m.team1 = tqc.batting_team THEN m.team2 
            ELSE m.team1 
        END AS opponent
    FROM TeamQualifierCount tqc
    JOIN Matches m ON tqc.match_id = m.match_id
    WHERE tqc.batting_team LIKE '%India%'
    ORDER BY m.match_date ASC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 
    batting_team,
    qualifiers,
    venue,
    match_date,
    season,
    opponent"

question: सीज़न 2026 में अपने पहले ओवर में सबसे अधिक रन देने वाले गेंदबाज कौन हैं?
gold_sql: WITH bowler_first_wc_match AS ( SELECT d.bowler_id, MIN(d.match_id) AS first_match_id FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE m.season = '2026' GROUP BY d.bowler_id ), first_over AS ( SELECT bfwm.bowler_id, d.match_id, d.inning, MIN(d.over_number) AS first_over_num FROM bowler_first_wc_match bfwm JOIN Deliveries d ON d.bowler_id = bfwm.bowler_id AND d.match_id = bfwm.first_match_id GROUP BY bfwm.bowler_id, d.match_id, d.inning ), first_over_runs AS ( SELECT fo.bowler_id, SUM(d.runs_scored + d.wides + d.noballs) AS runs_conceded FROM first_over fo JOIN Deliveries d ON d.bowler_id = fo.bowler_id AND d.match_id = fo.match_id AND d.inning = fo.inning AND d.over_number = fo.first_over_num GROUP BY fo.bowler_id, fo.match_id ) SELECT p.player_name, fr.runs_conceded FROM first_over_runs fr JOIN Players p ON fr.bowler_id = p.player_id ORDER BY fr.runs_conceded DESC LIMIT 5;
generated_sql:
WITH FirstOverDeliveries AS (
    SELECT 
        d.match_id,
        d.bowler_id,
        d.runs_scored,
        d.extra_runs,
        d.wides,
        d.noballs,
        m.season
    FROM Deliveries d
    JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
    WHERE m.season = '2026' 
      AND d.over_number = 1
),
BowlerRuns AS (
    SELECT 
        bowler_id,
        SUM(runs_scored + extra_runs) AS runs_conceded
    FROM FirstOverDeliveries
    GROUP BY bowler_id
)
SELECT 
    p.player_name,
    br.runs_conceded
FROM BowlerRuns br
JOIN Players p ON br.bowler_id = p.player_id
ORDER BY br.runs_conceded DESC
LIMIT 1;

question: Which bowlers have conceded the most runs in their first-ever over in T20 season 2026?
gold_sql: WITH bowler_first_wc_match AS ( SELECT d.bowler_id, MIN(d.match_id) AS first_match_id FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE m.season = '2026' GROUP BY d.bowler_id ), first_over AS ( SELECT bfwm.bowler_id, d.match_id, d.inning, MIN(d.over_number) AS first_over_num FROM bowler_first_wc_match bfwm JOIN Deliveries d ON d.bowler_id = bfwm.bowler_id AND d.match_id = bfwm.first_match_id GROUP BY bfwm.bowler_id, d.match_id, d.inning ), first_over_runs AS ( SELECT fo.bowler_id, SUM(d.runs_scored + d.wides + d.noballs) AS runs_conceded FROM first_over fo JOIN Deliveries d ON d.bowler_id = fo.bowler_id AND d.match_id = fo.match_id AND d.inning = fo.inning AND d.over_number = fo.first_over_num GROUP BY fo.bowler_id, fo.match_id ) SELECT p.player_name, fr.runs_conceded FROM first_over_runs fr JOIN Players p ON fr.bowler_id = p.player_id ORDER BY fr.runs_conceded DESC LIMIT 5;
generated_sql:
WITH BowlerFirstOver AS (
    SELECT 
        d.bowler_id,
        MIN(m.match_date) AS first_match_date,
        MIN(d.over_number) AS first_over
    FROM Deliveries d
    JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
    WHERE m.season = '2026'
    GROUP BY d.bowler_id
),
FirstOverDeliveries AS (
    SELECT 
        d.delivery_id,
        d.match_id,
        d.bowler_id,
        d.runs_scored,
        d.extra_runs,
        d.wides,
        d.noballs,
        d.byes,
        d.legbyes,
        bfo.first_match_date,
        bfo.first_over
    FROM Deliveries d
    JOIN BowlerFirstOver bfo ON d.bowler_id = bfo.bowler_id
    JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
    WHERE m.season = '2026'
    AND m.match_date = bfo.first_match_date
    AND d.over_number = bfo.first_over
)
SELECT 
    p.player_name,
    SUM(fod.runs_scored + fod.extra_runs - fod.byes - fod.legbyes) AS runs_conceded
FROM FirstOverDeliveries fod
JOIN Players p ON fod.bowler_id = p.player_id
GROUP BY fod.bowler_id, p.player_name
ORDER BY runs_conceded DESC;

question: Chepauk ਵਿੱਚ Sanju Samson ਦਾ T20 ਬੱਲੇਬਾਜ਼ੀ ਰਿਕਾਰਡ ਕੀ ਹੈ?
gold_sql: WITH innings_scores AS ( SELECT d.match_id, d.inning, d.striker_id, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS runs, COUNT(CASE WHEN d.wides=0 THEN 1 END) AS balls, SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id=d.striker_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dismissed FROM Deliveries d GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.striker_id ) SELECT p.player_name, COUNT(*) AS innings, SUM(s.runs) AS total_runs, ROUND(SUM(s.runs) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(s.dismissed),0),2) AS average, ROUND(SUM(s.runs)*100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(s.balls),0),2) AS strike_rate, MAX(s.runs) AS high_score FROM innings_scores s JOIN Players p ON s.striker_id = p.player_id JOIN Matches m ON s.match_id = m.match_id WHERE p.player_name LIKE '%Samson%' AND (m.venue LIKE '%Chepauk%' OR m.city LIKE '%Chennai%') GROUP BY p.player_name;
generated_sql:
WITH ChepaukMatches AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT match_id
    FROM Matches
    WHERE venue LIKE '%Chepauk%'
),
SamsonInnings AS (
    SELECT 
        d.match_id,
        d.inning,
        SUM(d.runs_scored) AS runs_in_innings,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 END) AS balls_faced,
        MAX(d.runs_scored) AS high_score
    FROM Deliveries d
    JOIN ChepaukMatches cm ON d.match_id = cm.match_id
    WHERE d.striker_id = (SELECT player_id FROM Players WHERE player_name = 'Sanju Samson')
    GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning
    HAVING balls_faced > 0
),
InningsSummary AS (
    SELECT 
        (SELECT player_name FROM Players WHERE player_name = 'Sanju Samson') AS player_name,
        COUNT(*) AS innings,
        SUM(runs_in_innings) AS total_runs,
        ROUND(AVG(runs_in_innings), 2) AS average,
        ROUND(CAST(SUM(runs_in_innings) AS FLOAT) * 100.0 / SUM(balls_faced), 2) AS strike_rate,
        MAX(high_score) AS high_score
    FROM SamsonInnings
)
SELECT * FROM InningsSummary;

question: Who are the players to score hundreds for England in T20 World Cups?
gold_sql: WITH innings_scores AS ( SELECT d.match_id, d.striker_id, d.batting_team, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS runs, CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id = d.striker_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0 THEN '*' ELSE '' END AS not_out FROM Deliveries d GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.striker_id, d.batting_team HAVING SUM(d.runs_scored) >= 100 ) SELECT p.player_name, s.runs, s.not_out, m.season, CASE WHEN m.team1 = 'England' THEN m.team2 ELSE m.team1 END AS opponent FROM innings_scores s JOIN Players p ON s.striker_id = p.player_id JOIN Matches m ON s.match_id = m.match_id WHERE s.batting_team = 'England' ORDER BY s.runs DESC;
generated_sql:
WITH EnglandMatches AS (
    SELECT match_id, season,
           CASE WHEN team1 = 'England' THEN team2 ELSE team1 END AS opponent
    FROM Matches
    WHERE (team1 = 'England' OR team2 = 'England')
      AND stage LIKE '%World Cup%'
),
PlayerRuns AS (
    SELECT 
        d.match_id,
        d.striker_id AS player_id,
        SUM(d.runs_scored) AS runs,
        MAX(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field') THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS not_out_flag
    FROM Deliveries d
    JOIN EnglandMatches em ON d.match_id = em.match_id
    WHERE d.batting_team = 'England'
    GROUP BY d.match_id, d.striker_id
    HAVING SUM(d.runs_scored) >= 100
)
SELECT 
    p.player_name,
    pr.runs,
    pr.not_out_flag AS not_out,
    em.season,
    em.opponent
FROM PlayerRuns pr
JOIN Players p ON pr.player_id = p.player_id
JOIN EnglandMatches em ON pr.match_id = em.match_id
ORDER BY pr.runs DESC;

question: T20 World Cups ਵਿੱਚ England ਲਈ ਸੈਂਕੜੇ ਬਣਾਉਣ ਵਾਲੇ ਖਿਡਾਰੀ ਕਿਹੜੇ ਹਨ?
gold_sql: WITH innings_scores AS ( SELECT d.match_id, d.striker_id, d.batting_team, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS runs, CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id = d.striker_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0 THEN '*' ELSE '' END AS not_out FROM Deliveries d GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.striker_id, d.batting_team HAVING SUM(d.runs_scored) >= 100 ) SELECT p.player_name, s.runs, s.not_out, m.season, CASE WHEN m.team1 = 'England' THEN m.team2 ELSE m.team1 END AS opponent FROM innings_scores s JOIN Players p ON s.striker_id = p.player_id JOIN Matches m ON s.match_id = m.match_id WHERE s.batting_team = 'England' ORDER BY s.runs DESC;
generated_sql:
WITH EnglandMatches AS (
    SELECT match_id, season, team1, team2
    FROM Matches
    WHERE stage LIKE '%World Cup%' AND (team1 = 'England' OR team2 = 'England')
),
EnglandInnings AS (
    SELECT 
        em.match_id,
        em.season,
        CASE 
            WHEN em.team1 = 'England' THEN em.team2
            ELSE em.team1
        END AS opponent,
        d.striker_id,
        d.runs_scored
    FROM EnglandMatches em
    JOIN Deliveries d ON em.match_id = d.match_id
    WHERE d.batting_team = 'England'
),
CenturyScorers AS (
    SELECT 
        striker_id,
        match_id,
        season,
        opponent,
        SUM(runs_scored) AS total_runs,
        CASE 
            WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN wicket_type IS NOT NULL AND player_out_id = striker_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0 THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS not_out_flag
    FROM EnglandInnings
    GROUP BY striker_id, match_id, season, opponent
    HAVING SUM(runs_scored) >= 100
)
SELECT 
    p.player_name,
    cs.total_runs AS runs,
    cs.not_out_flag AS not_out,
    cs.season,
    cs.opponent
FROM CenturyScorers cs
JOIN Players p ON cs.striker_id = p.player_id
ORDER BY cs.total_runs DESC;

question: T20 World Cup నాకౌట్ మ్యాచ్‌లలో అత్యధిక వ్యక్తిగత స్కోర్లు ఏవ?
gold_sql: WITH knockout_cte AS ( SELECT m.match_id FROM Matches m WHERE m.season IN ('2007','2009','2010','2012','2014','2016','2021/22','2022/23','2024','2025/26') AND m.team1 IN ('Afghanistan','Australia','Bangladesh','England','India','Ireland','New Zealand','Pakistan','South Africa','Sri Lanka','West Indies','Zimbabwe') AND m.team2 IN ('Afghanistan','Australia','Bangladesh','England','India','Ireland','New Zealand','Pakistan','South Africa','Sri Lanka','West Indies','Zimbabwe') AND m.stage IN ('Semi Final', 'Final') ), innings_scores AS ( SELECT d.match_id, d.striker_id, d.batting_team, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS runs, CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id=d.striker_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)=0 THEN '*' ELSE '' END AS not_out FROM Deliveries d GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.striker_id, d.batting_team ) SELECT p.player_name, s.runs, s.not_out, m.season, CASE WHEN m.team1=s.batting_team THEN m.team2 ELSE m.team1 END AS opponent FROM innings_scores s JOIN knockout_cte kc ON s.match_id = kc.match_id JOIN Players p ON s.striker_id = p.player_id JOIN Matches m ON s.match_id = m.match_id ORDER BY s.runs DESC LIMIT 10;
generated_sql:
WITH KnockoutMatches AS (
    SELECT match_id, season, team1, team2
    FROM Matches
    WHERE stage IN ('Semi Final', 'Final')
),
PlayerRunsInKnockout AS (
    SELECT 
        d.match_id,
        d.striker_id,
        m.season,
        CASE 
            WHEN d.striker_id IN (SELECT player_id FROM PlayerInMatch WHERE match_id = d.match_id AND team_name = m.team1) 
            THEN m.team2 
            ELSE m.team1 
        END AS opponent,
        SUM(d.runs_scored) AS runs,
        MAX(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL AND d.player_out_id = d.striker_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_out
    FROM Deliveries d
    JOIN KnockoutMatches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
    GROUP BY d.match_id, d.striker_id, m.season, opponent
)
SELECT 
    p.player_name,
    pr.runs,
    CASE WHEN pr.is_out = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS not_out,
    pr.season,
    pr.opponent
FROM PlayerRunsInKnockout pr

question: Which teams have played consecutive T20 World Cup finals?
gold_sql: WITH finals_cte AS ( SELECT m.match_id, m.season FROM Matches m WHERE m.season IN ('2007','2009','2010','2012','2014','2016','2021/22','2022/23','2024','2025/26') AND m.team1 IN ('Afghanistan','Australia','Bangladesh','England','India','Ireland','New Zealand','Pakistan','South Africa','Sri Lanka','West Indies','Zimbabwe') AND m.team2 IN ('Afghanistan','Australia','Bangladesh','England','India','Ireland','New Zealand','Pakistan','South Africa','Sri Lanka','West Indies','Zimbabwe') AND m.stage = 'Final' ), teams_in_finals AS ( SELECT f.season, m.team1 AS team FROM finals_cte f JOIN Matches m ON f.match_id = m.match_id UNION ALL SELECT f.season, m.team2 FROM finals_cte f JOIN Matches m ON f.match_id = m.match_id ), ranked AS ( SELECT team, season, LAG(season) OVER (PARTITION BY team ORDER BY season) AS prev_season FROM teams_in_finals ) SELECT DISTINCT team, season, prev_season FROM ranked WHERE prev_season IS NOT NULL ORDER BY season;
generated_sql:
WITH Finals AS (
    SELECT 
        season,
        match_date,
        team1 AS team
    FROM Matches
    WHERE stage = 'Final'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        season,
        match_date,
        team2 AS team
    FROM Matches
    WHERE stage = 'Final'
),
RankedFinals AS (
    SELECT 
        team,
        season,
        LAG(season) OVER (PARTITION BY team ORDER BY match_date) AS prev_season
    FROM Finals
)
SELECT 
    team,
    season,
    prev_season
FROM RankedFinals
WHERE prev_season IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY team, season;

question: What is the highest boundary count in a match in season 2026?
gold_sql: SELECT m.team1, m.team2, m.season, COUNT(CASE WHEN d.runs_scored = 4 AND d.wides = 0 THEN 1 END) AS fours, COUNT(CASE WHEN d.runs_scored = 6 AND d.wides = 0 THEN 1 END) AS sixes, COUNT(CASE WHEN d.runs_scored IN (4,6) AND d.wides = 0 THEN 1 END) AS total_boundaries FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE m.season = '2026' GROUP BY m.match_id, m.team1, m.team2, m.season ORDER BY total_boundaries DESC LIMIT 5;
generated_sql:
WITH MatchBoundaries AS (
    SELECT 
        m.match_id,
        m.team1,
        m.team2,
        m.season,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN d.runs_scored = 4 THEN 1 END) AS fours,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN d.runs_scored = 6 THEN 1 END) AS sixes,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN d.runs_scored IN (4, 6) THEN 1 END) AS total_boundaries
    FROM Matches m
    JOIN Deliveries d ON m.match_id = d.match_id
    WHERE m.season = '2026'
    GROUP BY m.match_id, m.team1, m.team2, m.season
)
SELECT 
    team1,
    team2,
    season,
    fours,
    sixes,
    total_boundaries
FROM MatchBoundaries
ORDER BY total_boundaries DESC

gold_sql: WITH finals_cte AS ( SELECT m.match_id, m.season FROM Matches m WHERE m.season IN ('2007','2009','2010','2012','2014','2016','2021/22','2022/23','2024','2025/26') AND m.team1 IN ('Afghanistan','Australia','Bangladesh','England','India','Ireland','New Zealand','Pakistan','South Africa','Sri Lanka','West Indies','Zimbabwe') AND m.team2 IN ('Afghanistan','Australia','Bangladesh','England','India','Ireland','New Zealand','Pakistan','South Africa','Sri Lanka','West Indies','Zimbabwe') AND m.stage = 'Final' ), teams_in_finals AS ( SELECT f.season, m.team1 AS team FROM finals_cte f JOIN Matches m ON f.match_id = m.match_id UNION ALL SELECT f.season, m.team2 FROM finals_cte f JOIN Matches m ON f.match_id = m.match_id ), ranked AS ( SELECT team, season, LAG(season) OVER (PARTITION BY team ORDER BY season) AS prev_season FROM teams_in_finals ) SELECT DISTINCT team, season, prev_season FROM ranked WHERE prev_season IS NOT NULL ORDER BY season;

    SELECT 
        match_id,
        season,
        stage,
        team1,
        team2
    FROM Matches
    WHERE stage = 'Final'
),
TeamAppearances AS (
    SELECT 
        season,
        team1 AS team
    FROM Finals
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        season,
        team2 AS team
    FROM Finals
),
ConsecutiveFinals AS (
    SELECT 
        ta1.season,
        ta1.team,
        LAG(ta1.season) OVER (PARTITION BY ta1.team ORDER BY ta1.season) AS prev_season
    FROM TeamAppearances ta1
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM TeamAppearances ta2
        WHERE ta2.team = ta1.team
          AND ta2.season = ta1.season - 1
    )
)

    team AS team,
    season AS season,
    prev_season AS prev_season
FROM ConsecutiveFinals

question: T20 World Cups లో England తరఫున శతకాలు చేసిన ఆటగాళ్ళు ఎవరు?
gold_sql: WITH innings_scores AS ( SELECT d.match_id, d.striker_id, d.batting_team, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS runs, CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id = d.striker_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0 THEN '*' ELSE '' END AS not_out FROM Deliveries d GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.striker_id, d.batting_team HAVING SUM(d.runs_scored) >= 100 ) SELECT p.player_name, s.runs, s.not_out, m.season, CASE WHEN m.team1 = 'England' THEN m.team2 ELSE m.team1 END AS opponent FROM innings_scores s JOIN Players p ON s.striker_id = p.player_id JOIN Matches m ON s.match_id = m.match_id WHERE s.batting_team = 'England' ORDER BY s.runs DESC;

WITH EnglandMatches AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.match_id, m.season, m.team1, m.team2
    FROM Matches m
    WHERE m.season LIKE '%T20 World Cup%'
      AND (m.team1 = 'England' OR m.team2 = 'England')
),
EnglandBatters AS (
    SELECT 
        p.player_id,
        p.player_name,
        d.match_id,
        m.season,
        CASE 
            WHEN m.team1 = 'England' THEN m.team2 
            ELSE m.team1 
        END AS opponent,
        SUM(d.runs_scored) AS runs_in_match,
        MAX(CASE 
            WHEN d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL 
                 AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field')
                 AND d.player_out_id = d.striker_id 
            THEN 1 
            ELSE 0 
        END) AS out_flag
    FROM Deliveries d
    JOIN EnglandMatches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
    JOIN Players p ON d.striker_id = p.player_id
    JOIN PlayerInMatch pim ON d.match_id = pim.match_id 
        AND d.striker_id = pim.player_id 
        AND pim.team_name = 'England'
    WHERE d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0
    GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name, d.match_id, m.season, opponent
    HAVING SUM(d.runs_scored) >= 100
)
SELECT 
    player_name,
    runs_in_match AS runs,
    CASE WHEN out_flag = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS not_out,
    season,
    opponent
FROM EnglandBatters
ORDER BY runs_in_match DESC, player_name;

gold_sql: SELECT m.team1, m.team2, m.season, SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) AS total_runs FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id GROUP BY m.match_id, m.team1, m.team2, m.season ORDER BY total_runs DESC LIMIT 10;
generated_sql:
WITH MatchTotals AS (
    SELECT 
        m.match_id,
        m.team1,
        m.team2,
        m.season,
        COALESCE(SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs), 0) AS total_runs
    FROM Matches m
    LEFT JOIN Deliveries d ON m.match_id = d.match_id
    WHERE m.stage = 'T20I'
    GROUP BY m.match_id, m.team1, m.team2, m.season
)
SELECT 
    team1,
    team2,
    season,
    total_runs
FROM MatchTotals
ORDER BY total_runs DESC
LIMIT 1;

question: सीज़न 2026 में सबसे महंगे गेंदबाजी आंकड़े कौन से हैं?
gold_sql: WITH bowling_innings AS ( SELECT d.match_id, d.inning, d.bowler_id, SUM(d.runs_scored + d.wides + d.noballs) AS runs_conceded, COUNT(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 END) AS legal_balls, COUNT(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id IS NOT NULL AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out','retired hurt','retired out', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 END) AS wickets FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE m.season = '2026' GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.bowler_id ) SELECT p.player_name, bi.wickets, bi.runs_conceded, bi.wickets || '/' || bi.runs_conceded AS figures, m.team1, m.team2, m.season FROM bowling_innings bi JOIN Players p ON bi.bowler_id = p.player_id JOIN Matches m ON bi.match_id = m.match_id ORDER BY bi.runs_conceded DESC LIMIT 10;
generated_sql:
WITH BowlerStats AS (
    SELECT 
        d.bowler_id,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL 
                    AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field') 
              THEN 1 END) AS wickets,
        SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) AS runs_conceded,
        m.season,
        m.team1,
        m.team2
    FROM Deliveries d
    JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
    WHERE m.season = '2026'
    GROUP BY d.bowler_id, m.match_id
),
RankedBowlers AS (
    SELECT 
        p.player_name,
        bs.wickets,
        bs.runs_conceded,
        bs.wickets || '/' || bs.runs_conceded AS figures,
        bs.team1,
        bs.team2,
        bs.season,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY bs.runs_conceded DESC, bs.wickets ASC) AS rank_expensive
    FROM BowlerStats bs
    JOIN Players p ON bs.bowler_id = p.player_id
    WHERE bs.wickets > 0
)
SELECT 
    player_name,
    wickets,
    runs_conceded,
    figures,
    team1,
    team2,
    season
FROM RankedBowlers
WHERE rank_expensive = 1;

question: What are the fastest team 100s in T20 World Cup knockouts?
gold_sql: WITH knockout_cte AS ( SELECT m.match_id FROM Matches m WHERE m.season IN ('2007','2009','2010','2012','2014','2016','2021/22','2022/23','2024','2025/26') AND m.team1 IN ('Afghanistan','Australia','Bangladesh','England','India','Ireland','New Zealand','Pakistan','South Africa','Sri Lanka','West Indies','Zimbabwe') AND m.team2 IN ('Afghanistan','Australia','Bangladesh','England','India','Ireland','New Zealand','Pakistan','South Africa','Sri Lanka','West Indies','Zimbabwe') AND m.stage IN ('Semi Final', 'Final') ), cumulative AS ( SELECT d.match_id, d.inning, d.batting_team, d.over_number, d.ball_number, d.delivery_id, SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) OVER (PARTITION BY d.match_id, d.inning ORDER BY d.delivery_id ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS running_total FROM Deliveries d JOIN knockout_cte kc ON d.match_id = kc.match_id ), first_100 AS ( SELECT match_id, inning, batting_team, MIN(over_number) AS over_when_100, MIN(ball_number) AS ball_when_100 FROM cumulative WHERE running_total >= 100 GROUP BY match_id, inning, batting_team ) SELECT f.batting_team, f.over_when_100, f.ball_when_100, m.team1, m.team2, m.season FROM first_100 f JOIN Matches m ON f.match_id = m.match_id WHERE f.batting_team IN ('Afghanistan','Australia','Bangladesh','England','India','Ireland','New Zealand','Pakistan','South Africa','Sri Lanka','West Indies','Zimbabwe') ORDER BY f.over_when_100, f.ball_when_100 LIMIT 10;
