WITH TeamRuns AS (
    SELECT 
        d.match_id,
        d.batting_team,
        d.inning,
        d.over_number,
        d.ball_number,
        SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) OVER (
            PARTITION BY d.match_id, d.batting_team, d.inning 
            ORDER BY d.over_number, d.ball_number
        ) AS cumulative_runs
    FROM Deliveries d
    JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
    WHERE m.stage IN ('Semi Final', 'Final')
),
Team100 AS (
    SELECT 
        tr.match_id,
        tr.batting_team,
        tr.inning,
        tr.over_number AS over_when_100,
        tr.ball_number AS ball_when_100,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY tr.match_id, tr.batting_team, tr.inning 
            ORDER BY tr.over_number, tr.ball_number
        ) AS rn
    FROM TeamRuns tr
    WHERE tr.cumulative_runs >= 100
),
First100 AS (
    SELECT 
        t100.match_id,
        t100.batting_team,
        t100.over_when_100,
        t100.ball_when_100
    FROM Team100 t100
    WHERE t100.rn = 1
)
SELECT 
    f.batting_team,
    f.over_when_100,
    f.ball_when_100,
    m.team1,
    m.team2,
    m.season
FROM First100 f
JOIN Matches m ON f.match_id = m.match_id
WHERE m.stage IN ('Semi Final', 'Final')
ORDER BY f.over_when_100, f.ball_when_100;

question: T20 World Cup नॉकआउट में टीम के 100 रन पूरे करने के सबसे तेज़ रिकॉर्ड कौन से हैं?
gold_sql: WITH knockout_cte AS ( SELECT m.match_id FROM Matches m WHERE m.season IN ('2007','2009','2010','2012','2014','2016','2021/22','2022/23','2024','2025/26') AND m.team1 IN ('Afghanistan','Australia','Bangladesh','England','India','Ireland','New Zealand','Pakistan','South Africa','Sri Lanka','West Indies','Zimbabwe') AND m.team2 IN ('Afghanistan','Australia','Bangladesh','England','India','Ireland','New Zealand','Pakistan','South Africa','Sri Lanka','West Indies','Zimbabwe') AND m.stage IN ('Semi Final', 'Final') ), cumulative AS ( SELECT d.match_id, d.inning, d.batting_team, d.over_number, d.ball_number, d.delivery_id, SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) OVER (PARTITION BY d.match_id, d.inning ORDER BY d.delivery_id ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS running_total FROM Deliveries d JOIN knockout_cte kc ON d.match_id = kc.match_id ), first_100 AS ( SELECT match_id, inning, batting_team, MIN(over_number) AS over_when_100, MIN(ball_number) AS ball_when_100 FROM cumulative WHERE running_total >= 100 GROUP BY match_id, inning, batting_team ) SELECT f.batting_team, f.over_when_100, f.ball_when_100, m.team1, m.team2, m.season FROM first_100 f JOIN Matches m ON f.match_id = m.match_id WHERE f.batting_team IN ('Afghanistan','Australia','Bangladesh','England','India','Ireland','New Zealand','Pakistan','South Africa','Sri Lanka','West Indies','Zimbabwe') ORDER BY f.over_when_100, f.ball_when_100 LIMIT 10;

WITH TeamRuns AS (
    SELECT 
        d.match_id,
        d.batting_team,
        d.inning,
        d.over_number,
        d.ball_number,
        SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) OVER (
            PARTITION BY d.match_id, d.batting_team, d.inning 
            ORDER BY d.inning, d.over_number, d.ball_number
        ) AS cumulative_runs
    FROM Deliveries d
    INNER JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
    WHERE m.stage IN ('Semi Final', 'Final')
),
Team100 AS (
    SELECT 
        tr.match_id,
        tr.batting_team,
        tr.inning,
        tr.over_number AS over_when_100,
        tr.ball_number AS ball_when_100,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY tr.match_id, tr.batting_team, tr.inning 
            ORDER BY tr.inning, tr.over_number, tr.ball_number
        ) AS rn
    FROM TeamRuns tr
    WHERE tr.cumulative_runs >= 100
),
First100 AS (
    SELECT 
        match_id,
        batting_team,
        over_when_100,
        ball_when_100
    FROM Team100
    WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT 
    f.batting_team,
    f.over_when_100,
    f.ball_when_100,
    m.team1,
    m.team2,
    m.season
FROM First100 f
INNER JOIN Matches m ON f.match_id = m.match_id
WHERE m.stage IN ('Semi Final', 'Final')
ORDER BY f.over_when_100, f.ball_when_100;

question: Which players have won the most Player of the Match awards in a single T20 World Cup edition?
gold_sql: SELECT p.player_name, m.season, COUNT(*) AS potm_awards FROM Matches m JOIN Players p ON m.player_of_match_id = p.player_id WHERE m.player_of_match_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY m.player_of_match_id, p.player_name, m.season ORDER BY potm_awards DESC LIMIT 10;
generated_sql:
WITH PlayerOfMatchCounts AS (
    SELECT 
        m.player_of_match_id,
        m.season,
        COUNT(*) AS potm_awards
    FROM Matches m
    WHERE m.player_of_match_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY m.player_of_match_id, m.season
),
MaxAwardsPerSeason AS (
    SELECT 
        season,
        MAX(potm_awards) AS max_awards
    FROM PlayerOfMatchCounts
    GROUP BY season
)
SELECT 
    p.player_name,
    pmc.season,
    pmc.potm_awards
FROM PlayerOfMatchCounts pmc
JOIN MaxAwardsPerSeason mas 
    ON pmc.season = mas.season 
    AND pmc.potm_awards = mas.max_awards
JOIN Players p 
    ON pmc.player_of_match_id = p.player_id
ORDER BY pmc.season, p.player_name;

WITH FullMemberTeams AS (

        SELECT team1 AS team_name FROM Matches
        UNION
        SELECT team2 AS team_name FROM Matches

question: Which teams have lost multiple T20 World Cup finals?
gold_sql: WITH finals_cte AS ( SELECT m.match_id, m.season FROM Matches m WHERE m.season IN ('2007','2009','2010','2012','2014','2016','2021/22','2022/23','2024','2025/26') AND m.team1 IN ('Afghanistan','Australia','Bangladesh','England','India','Ireland','New Zealand','Pakistan','South Africa','Sri Lanka','West Indies','Zimbabwe') AND m.team2 IN ('Afghanistan','Australia','Bangladesh','England','India','Ireland','New Zealand','Pakistan','South Africa','Sri Lanka','West Indies','Zimbabwe') AND m.stage = 'Final' ) SELECT CASE WHEN m.team1 = m.match_winner THEN m.team2 ELSE m.team1 END AS loser, COUNT(*) AS final_losses, GROUP_CONCAT(m.season, ', ') AS seasons FROM finals_cte f JOIN Matches m ON f.match_id = m.match_id WHERE m.match_winner IS NOT NULL GROUP BY loser HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2 ORDER BY final_losses DESC;
generated_sql:
WITH Finals AS (
    SELECT match_id, season, match_winner, team1, team2
    FROM Matches
    WHERE stage = 'Final'
),
Losers AS (
    SELECT 
        CASE 
            WHEN match_winner = team1 THEN team2
            ELSE team1
        END AS loser,
        season
    FROM Finals
    WHERE match_winner IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
    loser,
    COUNT(*) AS final_losses,
    GROUP_CONCAT(season, ', ') AS seasons
FROM Losers
GROUP BY loser
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
ORDER BY final_losses DESC;

)

question: Who has the most consecutive 50+ scores in T20 World Cups?
gold_sql: WITH innings_scores AS ( SELECT d.striker_id, d.match_id, d.inning, m.match_date, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS runs FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE m.season IN ('2007','2009','2010','2012','2014','2016','2021/22','2022/23','2024','2025/26') GROUP BY d.striker_id, d.match_id, d.inning, m.match_date ), numbered AS ( SELECT striker_id, match_id, inning, match_date, runs, CASE WHEN runs >= 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS fifty_plus, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY striker_id ORDER BY match_date, match_id, inning) AS rn FROM innings_scores ), grouped AS ( SELECT striker_id, fifty_plus, rn, rn - ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY striker_id, fifty_plus ORDER BY rn) AS grp FROM numbered ), streaks AS ( SELECT striker_id, grp, COUNT(*) AS streak_len FROM grouped WHERE fifty_plus = 1 GROUP BY striker_id, grp ) SELECT p.player_name, MAX(streak_len) AS max_consecutive_50_plus FROM streaks s JOIN Players p ON s.striker_id = p.player_id GROUP BY s.striker_id, p.player_name ORDER BY max_consecutive_50_plus DESC LIMIT 10;
generated_sql:
WITH PlayerMatchScores AS (
    SELECT 
        m.match_id,
        m.season,
        m.match_date,
        p.player_id,
        p.player_name,
        SUM(d.runs_scored) AS runs
    FROM Matches m
    JOIN Deliveries d ON m.match_id = d.match_id
    JOIN Players p ON d.striker_id = p.player_id
    WHERE m.stage LIKE '%T20 World Cup%'
    GROUP BY m.match_id, p.player_id, p.player_name, m.season, m.match_date
),
FiftyPlusMatches AS (
    SELECT 
        player_id,
        player_name,
        match_date,
        runs,
        CASE WHEN runs >= 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_fifty_plus
    FROM PlayerMatchScores
),
ConsecutiveGroups AS (
    SELECT 
        player_id,
        player_name,
        match_date,
        runs,
        is_fifty_plus,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY match_date) AS rn,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY player_id, is_fifty_plus ORDER BY match_date) AS group_rn
    FROM FiftyPlusMatches
    WHERE is_fifty_plus = 1
),
ConsecutiveCounts AS (
    SELECT 
        player_id,
        player_name,
        COUNT(*) AS consecutive_count
    FROM ConsecutiveGroups
    GROUP BY player_id, player_name, (rn - group_rn)
),
MaxConsecutive AS (
    SELECT 
        player_id,
        player_name,
        MAX(consecutive_count) AS max_consecutive_50_plus
    FROM ConsecutiveCounts
    GROUP BY player_id, player_name
)
SELECT 
    player_name,
    max_consecutive_50_plus
FROM MaxConsecutive
ORDER BY max_consecutive_50_plus DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH Finals AS (
    SELECT match_id, team1, team2, toss_winner, toss_decision, match_winner, result_type
    FROM Matches

),
MatchOutcomes AS (
    SELECT 
        match_id,
        match_winner,
        CASE 
            WHEN match_winner = team1 THEN team2
            WHEN match_winner = team2 THEN team1
            ELSE NULL
        END AS match_loser
    FROM Finals
    WHERE match_winner IS NOT NULL
),
InningsTotals AS (
    SELECT 
        d.match_id,
        d.inning,
        d.batting_team,
        SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) AS total_runs
    FROM Deliveries d
    JOIN Finals f ON d.match_id = f.match_id
    GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.batting_team
),
FirstInningScores AS (
    SELECT 
        match_id,
        batting_team AS team_batting_first,
        total_runs AS first_innings_total
    FROM InningsTotals
    WHERE inning = 1
),
SecondInningScores AS (
    SELECT 
        match_id,
        batting_team AS team_batting_second,
        total_runs AS second_innings_total
    FROM InningsTotals
    WHERE inning = 2
),
ChasingDefending AS (
    SELECT 
        mo.match_id,
        mo.match_winner,
        mo.match_loser,
        fis.team_batting_first,
        fis.first_innings_total,
        sis.team_batting_second,
        sis.second_innings_total,
        CASE 
            WHEN mo.match_winner = sis.team_batting_second THEN 'Chasing'
            WHEN mo.match_winner = fis.team_batting_first THEN 'Defending'
            ELSE 'Unknown'
        END AS win_type
    FROM MatchOutcomes mo
